```python
        self._refresh_database_info()
        self._load_last_user()

        self.showMaximized()

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Slots
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    def _refresh_database_info(self) -> None:
        """Show database status and populate users from the active directory."""
        database_path = self._data_dir / "profin.db"
        self._user_combo.clear()
        if not database_path.is_file():
            self._database_status.setText("BD no detectada en este directorio.")
            self._database_status.setProperty("databaseState", "missing")
            self._refresh_status_style()
            return

        try:
            users = get_database_users(self._data_dir)
            modified = datetime.fromtimestamp(
                database_path.stat().st_mtime
            ).strftime("%d/%m/%Y %H:%M:%S")
        except (OSError, sqlite3.DatabaseError) as exc:
            self._database_status.setText(f"No se pudo leer la BD: {exc}")
            self._database_status.setProperty("databaseState", "invalid")
            self._refresh_status_style()
            return

        self._database_status.setText(
            f"BD encontrada. Última modificación: {modified}"
        )
        self._database_status.setProperty("databaseState", "found")
        self._user_combo.addItems(users)
        self._refresh_status_style()

    def _refresh_status_style(self) -> None:
        self._database_status.style().unpolish(self._database_status)
        self._database_status.style().polish(self._database_status)

    def _select_data_folder(self) -> None:
        """Select a database folder, including an empty one for registration."""
        selected = QFileDialog.getExistingDirectory(
            self,
            "Seleccionar carpeta de la base de datos",
            self._data_folder.full_path() or str(get_default_data_dir()),
        )
        if not selected:
            return

        data_dir = Path(selected).expanduser().resolve()
        previous_value = self._settings.value("settings/data_folder", "", type=str)
        try:
            self._session.close()
            self._settings.setValue("settings/data_folder", str(data_dir))
            self._settings.sync()
            # init_db, not just refresh_runtime_paths: an older database in the
            # chosen folder must be integrity-checked and migrated before use.
            init_db()
            self._data_dir = database_module.DB_DIR
            self._session = get_session()
            self._data_folder.set_path(str(self._data_dir))
            self._refresh_database_info()
            self._lbl_error.setVisible(False)
        except (OSError, RuntimeError, sqlite3.DatabaseError) as exc:
            self._settings.setValue("settings/data_folder", previous_value)
            self._settings.sync()
            refresh_runtime_paths()
            self._session = get_session()
            self._show_error(f"No se pudo activar la base de datos:\n{exc}")

    def _on_login(self) -> None:
        username = self._user_combo.currentText().strip()
        password = self._inp_pass.text()

        if not username:
            self._show_error("Por favor introduce tu nombre de usuario.")
            return
        if not password:
            self._show_error("Por favor introduce tu contraseña.")
            return

        user = verify_login(self._session, username, password)

        if user is None:
            self._show_error("Usuario o contraseña incorrectos.")
            self._inp_pass.clear()
            self._inp_pass.setFocus()
            return

        # Persist last user
        self._settings.setValue(self.KEY_LAST_USER, username)
        self._settings.setValue(self.KEY_THEME,     self._theme)

        # Launch main window
        from app.gui.main_window import MainWindow
        self._main = MainWindow(user=user, session=self._session,
                                theme=self._theme)
        self._main.show()
        self.close()

    def _on_register(self) -> None:
        """Open the inline register dialog."""
        from PySide6.QtWidgets import QDialog, QDialogButtonBox

        t = THEMES[self._theme]

        dlg = QDialog(self)
        dlg.setWindowTitle("Crear nueva cuenta")
        dlg.setFixedWidth(360)
        dlg.setModal(True)

        layout = QVBoxLayout(dlg)
        layout.setContentsMargins(28, 28, 28, 28)
        layout.setSpacing(14)

        lbl_title = QLabel("Crear nueva cuenta")
        lbl_title.setFont(QFont("Segoe UI", 14, QFont.Weight.Bold))
        lbl_title.setAlignment(Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignCenter)
        layout.addWidget(lbl_title)

        lbl_u = QLabel("Usuario")
        lbl_u.setObjectName("fieldLabel")
        layout.addWidget(lbl_u)

        inp_user = QLineEdit()
        inp_user.setPlaceholderText("Elige un nombre de usuario")
        inp_user.setFixedHeight(40)
        inp_user.setObjectName("loginInput")
        layout.addWidget(inp_user)

        lbl_p = QLabel("Contraseña")
        lbl_p.setObjectName("fieldLabel")
        layout.addWidget(lbl_p)

        inp_pass = QLineEdit()
        inp_pass.setPlaceholderText("Elige una contraseña")
        inp_pass.setEchoMode(QLineEdit.EchoMode.Password)
        inp_pass.setFixedHeight(40)
        inp_pass.setObjectName("loginInput")
        layout.addWidget(inp_pass)

        lbl_p2 = QLabel("Confirmar contraseña")
        lbl_p2.setObjectName("fieldLabel")
        layout.addWidget(lbl_p2)

        inp_pass2 = QLineEdit()
        inp_pass2.setPlaceholderText("Repite la contraseña")
        inp_pass2.setEchoMode(QLineEdit.EchoMode.Password)
        inp_pass2.setFixedHeight(40)
        inp_pass2.setObjectName("loginInput")
        layout.addWidget(inp_pass2)

        lbl_err = QLabel("")
        lbl_err.setObjectName("loginError")
        lbl_err.setAlignment(Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignCenter)
        lbl_err.setVisible(False)
        layout.addWidget(lbl_err)

        btn_box = QDialogButtonBox()
        btn_create = btn_box.addButton(
            "Crear cuenta", QDialogButtonBox.ButtonRole.AcceptRole
        )
        btn_create.setObjectName("btnPrimary")
        btn_create.setFixedHeight(40)
        btn_cancel = btn_box.addButton(
            "Cancelar", QDialogButtonBox.ButtonRole.RejectRole
        )
        btn_cancel.setObjectName("btnSecondary")
        btn_cancel.setFixedHeight(40)
        layout.addWidget(btn_box)

        dlg.setStyleSheet(self.styleSheet())

        def _try_create() -> None:
            from app.auth.auth_service import create_user
            username = inp_user.text().strip()
            password = inp_pass.text()
            password2 = inp_pass2.text()

            if not username:
                lbl_err.setText("El nombre de usuario no puede estar vacío.")
                lbl_err.setVisible(True)
                return
            if not password:
                lbl_err.setText("La contraseña no puede estar vacía.")
                lbl_err.setVisible(True)
                return
            if password != password2:
                lbl_err.setText("Las contraseñas no coinciden.")
                lbl_err.setVisible(True)
                inp_pass2.clear()
                return
            if len(password) < 6:
                lbl_err.setText("La contraseña debe tener al menos 6 caracteres.")
                lbl_err.setVisible(True)
                return
            try:
                Base.metadata.create_all(bind=database_module.engine)
                create_user(self._session, username, password)
                dlg.accept()
                # Auto-fill username after successful registration
                if self._user_combo.findText(username) < 0:
                    self._user_combo.addItem(username)
                self._user_combo.setCurrentText(username)
                self._inp_pass.setFocus()
                self._show_error(
                    f"✓ Cuenta '{username}' creada. Introduce tu contraseña para entrar."
                )
                self._lbl_error.setStyleSheet(
                    f"color: {t['income']}; font-size: 12px;"
                )
            except ValueError as exc:
                lbl_err.setText(str(exc))
                lbl_err.setVisible(True)

        btn_box.accepted.connect(_try_create)
        btn_box.rejected.connect(dlg.reject)
        inp_pass2.returnPressed.connect(_try_create)

        dlg.exec()

    def _toggle_theme(self) -> None:
        self._theme = "dark" if self._theme == "light" else "light"
        self._apply_theme()

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Helpers
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    def _show_error(self, msg: str) -> None:
        self._lbl_error.setText(msg)
        self._lbl_error.setVisible(True)

    def _load_last_user(self) -> None:
        last = self._settings.value(self.KEY_LAST_USER, "")
        if last and self._user_combo.findText(last) >= 0:
            self._user_combo.setCurrentText(last)
            self._inp_pass.setFocus()
        else:
            self._user_combo.setFocus()

    def _apply_theme(self) -> None:
        t = THEMES[self._theme]
        is_dark = self._theme == "dark"

        # Theme button icon
        icon_name = "mdi.weather-night" if self._theme == "light" else "mdi.weather-sunny"
```

## `app/gui/rules_view.py`

```python
"""
app/gui/rules_view.py
======================
FAMILYFIN — Auto-Categorization Rules View (Fase 4b)

Features:
  - List of all rules (global + user) ordered by priority
  - Create new rule: pattern + match type + category + priority
  - Delete rule
  - Visual indicator for match type (contains/exact/regex)
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from typing import List

from PySide6.QtCore    import Qt
from PySide6.QtGui     import QFont, QColor, QStandardItemModel, QStandardItem
from PySide6.QtWidgets import (
    QWidget, QVBoxLayout, QHBoxLayout, QLabel,
    QPushButton, QFrame, QTableView, QHeaderView,
    QDialog, QLineEdit, QComboBox, QSpinBox,
    QFormLayout, QDialogButtonBox, QMessageBox,
    QAbstractItemView, QSizePolicy,
)
import qtawesome as qta

from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from app.config      import THEMES
from app.db.models   import (
    AutoCategorizationRule, MatchType, User, Category, CategoryLevel,
    Transaction,
)
from app.categorization.rules_engine  import (
    apply_rules, create_rule, delete_rule, get_all_rules, update_rule
)
from app.categorization.category_manager import get_all_categories
from app.gui._style_utils import apply_card_shadow


class RulesView(QWidget):

    def __init__(self, user: User, session: Session,
                 theme: str = "light") -> None:
        super().__init__()
        self._user    = user
        self._session = session
        self._theme   = theme
        self._t       = THEMES[theme]
        self._rules:  List[AutoCategorizationRule] = []
        self._categories: List[Category] = []

        self._build_ui()
        self._apply_theme()
        self._load_categories()
        self.refresh()

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # UI
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    def _build_ui(self) -> None:
        root = QVBoxLayout(self)
        root.setContentsMargins(0, 0, 0, 0)
        root.setSpacing(0)

        root.addWidget(self._make_topbar())

        # Table
        self._table = QTableView()
        self._table.setSelectionBehavior(
            QAbstractItemView.SelectionBehavior.SelectRows
        )
        self._table.setEditTriggers(
            QAbstractItemView.EditTrigger.NoEditTriggers
        )
        self._table.setAlternatingRowColors(True)
        self._table.setShowGrid(False)
        self._table.setSortingEnabled(True)
        self._table.verticalHeader().setVisible(False)

        self._model = QStandardItemModel()
        self._model.setHorizontalHeaderLabels([
            "Prioridad", "Patrón", "Tipo match",
            "Categoría", "Ámbito", "Transacciones vinculadas",
            "Total (€)",
        ])
        self._table.setModel(self._model)

        hdr = self._table.horizontalHeader()
        hdr.setSectionResizeMode(0, QHeaderView.ResizeMode.ResizeToContents)
        hdr.setSectionResizeMode(1, QHeaderView.ResizeMode.Stretch)
        hdr.setSectionResizeMode(2, QHeaderView.ResizeMode.ResizeToContents)
        hdr.setSectionResizeMode(3, QHeaderView.ResizeMode.ResizeToContents)
        hdr.setSectionResizeMode(4, QHeaderView.ResizeMode.ResizeToContents)
        hdr.setSectionResizeMode(5, QHeaderView.ResizeMode.ResizeToContents)
        hdr.setSectionResizeMode(6, QHeaderView.ResizeMode.ResizeToContents)

        root.addWidget(self._table)

        # Bottom bar
        bottom = QFrame()
        self._bottom_bar = bottom
        bottom.setObjectName("rulesBottom")
        bottom.setFixedHeight(52)
        bl = QHBoxLayout(bottom)
        bl.setContentsMargins(16, 8, 16, 8)
        bl.setSpacing(10)

        self._lbl_count = QLabel("")
        self._lbl_count.setObjectName("rulesCount")
        bl.addWidget(self._lbl_count)

        bl.addStretch()

        btn_edit = QPushButton("  Editar regla")
        btn_edit.setIcon(
            qta.icon("mdi.pencil-outline", color="#FFFFFF")
        )
        btn_edit.setFixedHeight(36)
        btn_edit.setObjectName("btnSecondary")
        btn_edit.setCursor(Qt.CursorShape.PointingHandCursor)
        btn_edit.setToolTip("Editar la regla seleccionada")
        btn_edit.clicked.connect(self._on_edit_rule)
        bl.addWidget(btn_edit)

        btn_del = QPushButton("  Eliminar regla")
        btn_del.setIcon(
            qta.icon("mdi.delete-outline", color="#FFFFFF")
        )
        btn_del.setFixedHeight(36)
        btn_del.setObjectName("btnDanger")
        btn_del.setCursor(Qt.CursorShape.PointingHandCursor)
        btn_del.clicked.connect(self._on_delete)
        bl.addWidget(btn_del)

        btn_apply = QPushButton("  Aplicar reglas a transacciones")
        btn_apply.setIcon(
            qta.icon("mdi.auto-fix", color="#FFFFFF")
        )
        btn_apply.setFixedHeight(36)
        btn_apply.setObjectName("btnAccent")
        btn_apply.setCursor(Qt.CursorShape.PointingHandCursor)
        btn_apply.setToolTip(
            "Aplica todas las reglas activas a las transacciones sin categorizar"
        )
        btn_apply.clicked.connect(self._on_apply_rules)
        bl.addWidget(btn_apply)

        root.addWidget(bottom)

    def _make_topbar(self) -> QFrame:
        bar = QFrame()
        bar.setObjectName("dashTopBar")
        bar.setFixedHeight(56)
        layout = QHBoxLayout(bar)
        layout.setContentsMargins(24, 0, 24, 0)

        lbl = QLabel("Reglas de auto-categorización")
        lbl.setFont(QFont("Segoe UI", 15, QFont.Weight.Bold))
        lbl.setObjectName("dashTitle")
        layout.addWidget(lbl)

        layout.addStretch()

        btn_new = QPushButton("  Nueva regla")
        btn_new.setIcon(
            qta.icon("mdi.plus", color="#FFFFFF")
        )
        btn_new.setFixedHeight(34)
        btn_new.setObjectName("btnPrimary")
        btn_new.setCursor(Qt.CursorShape.PointingHandCursor)
        btn_new.clicked.connect(self._on_new_rule)
        layout.addWidget(btn_new)

        return bar

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Data
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    def _load_categories(self) -> None:
        self._categories = get_all_categories(
            self._session, self._user.id, level=CategoryLevel.category
        )

    def refresh(self) -> None:
        self._rules = get_all_rules(self._session, user_id=self._user.id)
        self._model.removeRows(0, self._model.rowCount())
        t = self._t
        rule_transactions = self._get_rule_transactions()

        cat_map = {c.id: c.name for c in self._categories}
        match_labels = {
            MatchType.contains: "Contiene",
            MatchType.exact:    "Exacto",
            MatchType.regex:    "Regex",
        }
        match_colors = {
            MatchType.contains: t["accent"],
            MatchType.exact:    t["income"],
            MatchType.regex:    t["investment"],
        }

        for rule in self._rules:
            item_pri = QStandardItem(str(rule.priority))
            item_pri.setData(rule.id, Qt.ItemDataRole.UserRole)
            item_pri.setTextAlignment(Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignCenter)

            item_pat = QStandardItem(rule.match_pattern)

            item_mt = QStandardItem(
                match_labels.get(rule.match_type, str(rule.match_type))
            )
            item_mt.setForeground(
                QColor(match_colors.get(rule.match_type, t["text_primary"]))
            )
            item_mt.setTextAlignment(Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignCenter)
            item_mt.setFont(QFont("Segoe UI", 11, QFont.Weight.Bold))

            cat_name = cat_map.get(rule.category_id, f"id={rule.category_id}")
            item_cat = QStandardItem(cat_name)

            scope = "Global" if rule.user_id is None else "Personal"
            item_scope = QStandardItem(scope)
            item_scope.setTextAlignment(Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignCenter)
            if scope == "Global":
                item_scope.setForeground(QColor(t["investment"]))
            else:
                item_scope.setForeground(QColor(t["text_secondary"]))

            linked_transactions = rule_transactions.get(rule.id, [])
            item_linked = QStandardItem(str(len(linked_transactions)))
            item_linked.setTextAlignment(Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignCenter)

            total_amount = sum(
                transaction.amount for transaction in linked_transactions
            )
            item_total = QStandardItem(_format_amount(total_amount))
            item_total.setTextAlignment(Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignRight)

            row = [
                item_pri, item_pat, item_mt, item_cat, item_scope,
                item_linked, item_total,
            ]
            for item in row:
                item.setEditable(False)
            self._model.appendRow(row)

        self._lbl_count.setText(
            f"{len(self._rules)} regla(s) activa(s)"
        )

    def _get_rule_transactions(
        self,
    ) -> dict[int, List[Transaction]]:
        """Return transactions assigned to each rule using current priorities."""
        transaction_ids = [
            row.id for row in self._session.query(Transaction.id).filter(
                Transaction.user_id == self._user.id
            ).all()
        ]
        if not transaction_ids:
            return {}

        result = apply_rules(
            self._session, transaction_ids, self._user.id
        )
        transactions = self._session.query(Transaction).filter(
            Transaction.id.in_(result.assigned)
        ).all()
        transactions_by_id = {transaction.id: transaction for transaction in transactions}
        return {
            rule_id: [
                transactions_by_id[transaction_id]
                for transaction_id in assigned_ids
                if transaction_id in transactions_by_id
            ]
            for rule_id, assigned_ids in result.transaction_ids_by_rule.items()
        }

    def _selected_rule(self) -> AutoCategorizationRule | None:
        """Return the rule represented by the currently selected table row."""
        idx = self._table.currentIndex()
        if not idx.isValid():
            return None

        rule_id = self._model.item(idx.row(), 0).data(Qt.ItemDataRole.UserRole)
        return next((rule for rule in self._rules if rule.id == rule_id), None)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Slots
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    def _on_new_rule(self) -> None:
        # Always reload categories before opening the dialog
        # in case they were added in the Categories view after this view loaded
        self._load_categories()

        if not self._categories:
            QMessageBox.warning(
                self, "Sin categorías",
                "No hay categorías disponibles.\n\n"
                "Ve a la pantalla 'Categorías' → pulsa 'Cargar categorías "
                "por defecto' y vuelve aquí."
            )
            return

        t = self._t

        dlg = QDialog(self)
        dlg.setWindowTitle("Nueva regla de auto-categorización")
        dlg.setFixedWidth(440)
        dlg.setModal(True)

        layout = QVBoxLayout(dlg)
        layout.setContentsMargins(24, 24, 24, 24)
        layout.setSpacing(14)

        form = QFormLayout()
        form.setSpacing(10)

        # Pattern
        inp_pattern = QLineEdit()
        inp_pattern.setPlaceholderText("ej: MERCADONA, ^REPSOL, NOMINA PEDRO")
        inp_pattern.setFixedHeight(38)
        form.addRow("Patrón:", inp_pattern)

        # Match type
        cmb_type = QComboBox()
        cmb_type.setFixedHeight(38)
        cmb_type.addItem("Contiene (substring)", MatchType.contains)
        cmb_type.addItem("Exacto (full match)",  MatchType.exact)
        cmb_type.addItem("Regex (expresión regular)", MatchType.regex)
        form.addRow("Tipo de match:", cmb_type)

        # Category
        cmb_cat = QComboBox()
        cmb_cat.setFixedHeight(38)
        for cat in self._categories:
            cmb_cat.addItem(cat.name, cat.id)
        form.addRow("Categoría:", cmb_cat)

        # Priority
        spn_pri = QSpinBox()
        spn_pri.setRange(1, 999)
        spn_pri.setValue(100)
        spn_pri.setFixedHeight(38)
        form.addRow("Prioridad (1=mayor):", spn_pri)

        # Scope
        cmb_scope = QComboBox()
        cmb_scope.setFixedHeight(38)
        cmb_scope.addItem("Global (todos los usuarios)", None)
        cmb_scope.addItem("Personal (solo yo)",         self._user.id)
        form.addRow("Ámbito:", cmb_scope)

        layout.addLayout(form)

        # Hint
        lbl_hint = QLabel(
            "💡 Tip: usa <b>Contiene</b> para la mayoría de casos. "
            "Usa <b>Regex</b> para patrones avanzados."
        )
        lbl_hint.setWordWrap(True)
        lbl_hint.setStyleSheet(
            f"color: {t['text_secondary']}; font-size: 11px;"
        )
        layout.addWidget(lbl_hint)

        btn_box = QDialogButtonBox(
            QDialogButtonBox.StandardButton.Ok |
            QDialogButtonBox.StandardButton.Cancel
        )
        btn_box.button(QDialogButtonBox.StandardButton.Ok).setText("Crear regla")
        btn_box.button(QDialogButtonBox.StandardButton.Ok).setObjectName("btnPrimary")
        btn_box.accepted.connect(dlg.accept)
        btn_box.rejected.connect(dlg.reject)
        layout.addWidget(btn_box)

        dlg.setStyleSheet(f"""
            QDialog {{ background-color: {t["bg_secondary"]}; }}
            QLineEdit, QComboBox, QSpinBox {{
                background-color: {t["bg_primary"]};
                border: 1.5px solid {t["border"]};
                border-radius: 6px;
                padding: 4px 10px;
                color: {t["text_primary"]};
                font-size: 13px;
            }}
            QLineEdit:focus, QComboBox:focus, QSpinBox:focus {{
                border-color: {t["accent"]};
            }}
            QLabel {{
                color: {t["text_primary"]};
                font-size: 13px;
            }}
            QPushButton#btnPrimary {{
                background-color: {t["accent"]}; color: #FFFFFF;
                border: none; border-radius: 6px;
                font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600;
                padding: 6px 16px;
            }}
        """)

        if dlg.exec() != QDialog.DialogCode.Accepted:
            return

        pattern  = inp_pattern.text().strip()
        mt       = cmb_type.currentData()
        cat_id   = cmb_cat.currentData()
        priority = spn_pri.value()
        scope    = cmb_scope.currentData()

        if not pattern:
            QMessageBox.warning(
                self, "Patrón vacío",
                "El patrón no puede estar vacío."
            )
            return

        if cat_id is None:
            QMessageBox.warning(
                self, "Sin categoría",
                "Selecciona una categoría válida para la regla.\n\n"
                "Si no hay categorías disponibles, ve a la pantalla "
                "'Categorías' y carga las categorías por defecto primero."
            )
            return

        try:
            create_rule(
                self._session,
                category_id   = cat_id,
                match_pattern = pattern,
                match_type    = mt,
                priority      = priority,
                user_id       = scope,
            )
            self.refresh()
        except Exception as exc:
            QMessageBox.critical(self, "Error al crear regla", str(exc))

    def _on_apply_rules(self) -> None:
        """
        Apply all active rules to every uncategorized transaction
        belonging to this user and refresh the rules count label.
        """
        import logging
        _log = logging.getLogger(__name__)

        try:
            from app.db.models import Transaction
            from app.categorization.rules_engine import apply_rules_and_commit

            # Get ALL uncategorized transaction IDs for this user
            # Re-process ALL transactions — overwrite=True ensures
            # that transactions already categorized by a previous
            # version of the rule are updated with the new category.
            # Manually categorized ones (category_source='manual') are
            # always kept by apply_rules_and_commit.
            all_ids = [
                row.id for row in (
                    self._session.query(Transaction.id)
                    .filter(Transaction.user_id == self._user.id)
                    .all()
                )
            ]

            if not all_ids:
                QMessageBox.information(
                    self,
                    "Sin transacciones",
                    "No hay transacciones en la base de datos.",
                )
                return

            result = apply_rules_and_commit(
                self._session,
                all_ids,
                self._user.id,
                overwrite=True,
            )

            n_assigned  = len(result.assigned)
            n_conflict  = len(result.conflicts)
            n_unmatched = len(result.unmatched)

            _log.info(
                "Reglas aplicadas: %d asignadas, %d conflictos, %d sin match",
                n_assigned, n_conflict, n_unmatched,
            )

            msg = (
                f"<b>{n_assigned}</b> transacciones categorizadas automáticamente."
            )
            if n_conflict:
                msg += (
                    f"<br><b>{n_conflict}</b> transacciones con conflicto de reglas "
                    f"(múltiples reglas coinciden) — requieren revisión manual."
                )
            if n_unmatched:
                msg += (
                    f"<br><b>{n_unmatched}</b> transacciones sin coincidencia "
                    f"— permanecen sin categorizar."
                )

            QMessageBox.information(self, "Reglas aplicadas", msg)
            self.refresh()

        except Exception as exc:
            QMessageBox.critical(
                self, "Error al aplicar reglas", str(exc)
            )

    def _on_edit_rule(self) -> None:
        """Open a pre-filled dialog to edit the selected rule."""
        rule = self._selected_rule()
        if rule is None:
            QMessageBox.information(
                self, "Sin selección",
                "Selecciona una regla para editar."
            )
            return

        self._load_categories()

        if not self._categories:
            QMessageBox.warning(
                self, "Sin categorías",
                "No hay categorías disponibles para asignar."
            )
            return

        t = self._t

        dlg = QDialog(self)
        dlg.setWindowTitle(f"Editar regla — '{rule.match_pattern}'")
        dlg.setFixedWidth(440)
        dlg.setModal(True)

        layout = QVBoxLayout(dlg)
        layout.setContentsMargins(24, 24, 24, 24)
        layout.setSpacing(14)

        form = QFormLayout()
        form.setSpacing(10)

        # Pattern — pre-filled
        inp_pattern = QLineEdit(rule.match_pattern)
        inp_pattern.setFixedHeight(38)
        form.addRow("Patrón:", inp_pattern)

        # Match type — pre-selected
        cmb_type = QComboBox()
        cmb_type.setFixedHeight(38)
        cmb_type.addItem("Contiene (substring)",      MatchType.contains)
        cmb_type.addItem("Exacto (full match)",        MatchType.exact)
        cmb_type.addItem("Regex (expresión regular)",  MatchType.regex)
        cmb_type.setCurrentIndex(
            [MatchType.contains, MatchType.exact, MatchType.regex]
            .index(rule.match_type)
        )
        form.addRow("Tipo de match:", cmb_type)

        # Category — pre-selected
        cmb_cat = QComboBox()
        cmb_cat.setFixedHeight(38)
        for cat in self._categories:
            cmb_cat.addItem(cat.name, cat.id)
        # Select current category
        for i in range(cmb_cat.count()):
            if cmb_cat.itemData(i) == rule.category_id:
                cmb_cat.setCurrentIndex(i)
                break
        form.addRow("Categoría:", cmb_cat)

        # Priority — pre-filled
        spn_pri = QSpinBox()
        spn_pri.setRange(1, 999)
        spn_pri.setValue(rule.priority)
        spn_pri.setFixedHeight(38)
        form.addRow("Prioridad (1=mayor):", spn_pri)

        # Scope — pre-selected (read-only info, scope cannot change)
        scope_label = "Global" if rule.user_id is None else "Personal"
        lbl_scope = QLabel(scope_label)
        lbl_scope.setFixedHeight(38)
        form.addRow("Ámbito:", lbl_scope)

        layout.addLayout(form)

        # Dialog buttons
        btns = QDialogButtonBox(
            QDialogButtonBox.StandardButton.Save |
            QDialogButtonBox.StandardButton.Cancel
        )
        btns.button(QDialogButtonBox.StandardButton.Save).setText("  Guardar cambios")
        btns.button(QDialogButtonBox.StandardButton.Cancel).setText("  Cancelar")
        btns.accepted.connect(dlg.accept)
        btns.rejected.connect(dlg.reject)
        layout.addWidget(btns)

        dlg.setStyleSheet(f"""
            QDialog {{ background-color: {t["bg_primary"]}; }}
            QLabel  {{ color: {t["text_primary"]}; font-size: 13px; }}
            QLineEdit, QComboBox, QSpinBox {{
                background-color: {t["bg_secondary"]};
                color: {t["text_primary"]};
                border: 1px solid {t["border"]};
                border-radius: 6px; padding: 0 10px;
            }}
            QLineEdit:focus, QComboBox:focus, QSpinBox:focus {{
                border-color: {t["accent"]};
            }}
        """)

        if dlg.exec() != QDialog.DialogCode.Accepted:
            return

        pattern  = inp_pattern.text().strip()
        mt       = cmb_type.currentData()
        cat_id   = cmb_cat.currentData()
        priority = spn_pri.value()

        if not pattern:
            QMessageBox.warning(self, "Patrón vacío",
                                "El patrón no puede estar vacío.")
            return

        if cat_id is None:
            QMessageBox.warning(self, "Sin categoría",
                                "Selecciona una categoría válida.")
            return

        try:
            update_rule(
                self._session,
                rule_id       = rule.id,
                category_id   = cat_id,
                match_pattern = pattern,
                match_type    = mt,
                priority      = priority,
            )
            self.refresh()
            QMessageBox.information(
                self, "Regla actualizada",
                f"Regla <b>'{pattern}'</b> actualizada correctamente."
            )
        except Exception as exc:
            QMessageBox.critical(self, "Error al editar regla", str(exc))

    def _on_delete(self) -> None:
        rule = self._selected_rule()
        if rule is None:
            QMessageBox.information(
                self, "Sin selección",
                "Selecciona una regla para eliminar."
            )
            return

        reply = QMessageBox.question(
            self,
            "Confirmar eliminación",
            f"¿Eliminar la regla <b>'{rule.match_pattern}'</b>?",
            QMessageBox.StandardButton.Yes |
            QMessageBox.StandardButton.No
        )
        if reply != QMessageBox.StandardButton.Yes:
            return
        try:
            delete_rule(self._session, rule.id)
            self.refresh()
        except ValueError as exc:
            QMessageBox.warning(self, "Error", str(exc))

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Theme
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    def apply_theme(self, theme_key: str) -> None:
        self._theme = theme_key
        self._t = THEMES[theme_key]
        self._apply_theme()

    def _apply_theme(self) -> None:
        t = self._t
        is_dark = self._theme == "dark"
        selection_bg = (
            f"background-color: {t['accent']}; color: #FFFFFF;"
            if is_dark else
            f"background: qlineargradient(x1:0, y1:0, x2:1, y2:0, "
            f"stop:0 {t['selection_grad_start']}, stop:1 {t['selection_grad_end']}); "
            f"color: {t['selection_text']};"
        )
        selection_hover = (
            f"background-color: {t['accent_hover']}; color: #FFFFFF;"
            if is_dark else
            f"background: qlineargradient(x1:0, y1:0, x2:1, y2:0, "
            f"stop:0 {t['selection_hover_start']}, stop:1 {t['selection_hover_end']}); "
            f"color: {t['selection_text']};"
        )
        self.setStyleSheet(f"""
            QFrame#dashTopBar {{
                background-color: {t["bg_secondary"]};
                border-bottom: 1px solid {t["border"]};
            }}
            QLabel#dashTitle {{
                color: {t["text_primary"]};
                font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700;
            }}
            QPushButton#btnPrimary {{
                background-color: {t["accent"]}; color: #FFFFFF;
                border: none; border-radius: 8px;
                font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600;
                padding: 0 16px;
            }}
            QPushButton#btnPrimary:hover {{
                background-color: {t["accent_hover"]};
            }}
            QPushButton#btnDanger {{
                background-color: {t["expense"]}; color: #FFFFFF;
                border: none; border-radius: 8px;
                font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600;
                padding: 0 16px;
            }}
            QPushButton#btnDanger:disabled {{
                background-color: {t["border"]};
                color: {t["text_secondary"]};
            }}
            QPushButton#btnSecondary {{
                background-color: transparent;
                color: {t["text_primary"]};
                border: 1px solid {t["border"]};
                border-radius: 8px;
                font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600;
                padding: 0 16px;
            }}
            QPushButton#btnSecondary:hover {{
                background-color: {t["bg_hover"]};
            }}
            QPushButton#btnAccent {{
                background-color: {t["income"]}; color: #FFFFFF;
                border: none; border-radius: 8px;
                font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600;
                padding: 0 16px;
            }}
            QPushButton#btnAccent:hover {{
                background-color: {t["income_hover"]};
            }}
            QTableView {{
                background-color: {t["bg_secondary"]};
                border: none; color: {t["text_primary"]};
                font-size: 12px;
                alternate-background-color: {t["bg_primary"]};
            }}
            QTableView::item {{
                padding: 8px;
                border-bottom: 1px solid {t["border"]};
            }}
            QTableView::item:hover {{
                background-color: {t["bg_hover"]};
                color: {t["text_primary"]};
            }}
            QTableView::item:selected {{
                {selection_bg}
            }}
            QTableView::item:selected:hover {{
                {selection_hover}
            }}
            QHeaderView::section {{
                background-color: {t["bg_primary"]};
                color: {t["text_secondary"]};
                font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700;
                padding: 6px 8px; border: none;
                border-bottom: 2px solid {t["border"]};
                text-transform: uppercase;
            }}
            QFrame#rulesBottom {{
                background-color: {t["bg_secondary"]};
                border-top: 1px solid {t["border"]};
            }}
            QLabel#rulesCount {{
                color: {t["text_secondary"]};
                font-size: 12px;
            }}
        """)
        apply_card_shadow(self._bottom_bar, t, blur_radius=12, y_offset=-2)


def _format_amount(value: float) -> str:
    """Format signed amounts with Spanish separators and euro suffix."""
    return (
        f"{value:,.2f} €"
        .replace(",", "X")
        .replace(".", ",")
        .replace("X", ".")
    )
```

```python
        self._theme_cb.setCurrentText("Claro" if self._settings.theme == "light" else "Oscuro")

        self._export_folder_edit.setText(self._settings.export_folder)

        self._backup_folder_edit.setText(self._settings.backup_folder)

        self._protect_data_cb.setChecked(self._settings.protect_sensitive_data)

        settings = self._settings
        settings.language = "es" if self._language_cb.currentText() == "Español" else "en"
        settings.default_period = self._default_period_cb.currentText()
        settings.default_currency = {
            "EUR (€)": "EUR",
            "USD ($)": "USD",
            "GBP (£)": "GBP",
        }[self._currency_cb.currentText()]
        settings.theme = "light" if self._theme_cb.currentText() == "Claro" else "dark"
        settings.save_appearance_on_start = self._save_appearance_start_cb.isChecked()
        settings.enable_hints = self._show_hints_cb.isChecked()
        settings.import_folder = self._import_folder_edit.text().strip()
        settings.export_folder = self._export_folder_edit.text().strip()
        settings.data_folder = self._data_folder_edit.text().strip()
        settings.backup_folder = self._backup_folder_edit.text().strip()
        settings.require_password_on_start = self._require_password_cb.isChecked()
        settings.protect_sensitive_data = self._protect_data_cb.isChecked()
        settings.auto_backup = self._auto_backup_cb.isChecked()
        settings.backup_interval_hours = self._backup_interval_spin.value()
        settings.weekly_summary_email = self._weekly_summary_cb.isChecked()
        self._settings = settings

    def _browse_folder(self, field: QLineEdit) -> None:
        folder = QFileDialog.getExistingDirectory(self, "Seleccionar carpeta", field.text() or ".")
        if folder:
            field.setText(folder)

    def _detect_data_folder(self) -> None:
        candidates = []
        for folder in (get_legacy_data_dir(), get_default_data_dir()):
            if database_has_users(folder / "profin.db"):
                candidates.append(folder)

        if not candidates:
            QMessageBox.information(
                self,
                "Base de datos no encontrada",
                "No se encontró una base de datos con usuarios válidos en las rutas conocidas del proyecto ni del usuario local.",
            )
            return

        chosen = sorted(candidates, key=lambda path: len(str(path))) [0]
        self._data_folder_edit.setText(str(chosen))
        QMessageBox.information(
            self,
            "Base de datos detectada",
            f"Se ha localizado la base de datos actual en:\n{chosen}",
        )

    def _save_settings(self) -> None:
        self._collect_from_form()
        # save() overwrites settings/data_folder, so remember the folder in use.
        current_data_dir = get_user_data_dir()
        self._settings_manager.ensure_dirs(self._settings)
        self._settings_manager.save(self._settings)

        qsettings = QSettings("FAMILYFIN", "FAMILYFIN")
        qsettings.setValue("ui/theme", self._settings.theme if self._settings.save_appearance_on_start else "light")
        qsettings.sync()

        parent = self.parentWidget()
        while parent is not None and not hasattr(parent, "_theme"):
            parent = parent.parentWidget()
        if parent is not None:
            parent._theme = self._settings.theme
            parent._t = THEMES[self._settings.theme]
            if hasattr(parent, "_apply_theme"):
                parent._apply_theme()
            if hasattr(parent, "_views"):
                for view in parent._views.values():
                    if hasattr(view, "apply_theme"):
                        view.apply_theme(self._settings.theme)
                    elif hasattr(view, "refresh_theme"):
                        view.refresh_theme(self._settings.theme)
        self.apply_theme(self._settings.theme)

        if self._settings.data_folder:
            try:
                self._switch_data_folder(self._settings.data_folder, current_data_dir)
            except Exception as exc:
                logger.exception("No se pudo cambiar la carpeta de datos.")
                QMessageBox.critical(self, "Error al migrar datos", str(exc))

    def _migrate_data_folder(self) -> None:
        target = self._data_folder_edit.text().strip()
        if not target:
            QMessageBox.warning(self, "Ubicación no válida", "Selecciona una carpeta para la ubicación de datos del usuario.")
            return
        try:
            self._settings.data_folder = target
            if not self._switch_data_folder(target, get_user_data_dir()):
                QMessageBox.information(self, "Ubicación de datos", f"Los datos ya se guardan en:\n{target}")
        except Exception as exc:
            logger.exception("No se pudo cambiar la carpeta de datos.")
            QMessageBox.critical(self, "Error al migrar datos", str(exc))

    def _switch_data_folder(self, target: str, current_dir: Path) -> bool:
        """Move the app to another data folder. Returns False if it was already in use.

        The live session is bound to the old database file, so after the
        switch the database is re-initialised (integrity check + schema
        migrations) and the user is logged out; logging in again opens a
        session on the new file and nothing more is written to the old one.
        """
        new_dir = self._settings_manager.apply_data_folder(target, current_dir=current_dir)
        if new_dir.resolve() == current_dir.resolve():
            return False
        self._session.commit()
        init_db()
        # Web sessions belong to users of the previous database.
        from app.web.server import get_web_server
        get_web_server().sessions.revoke_all()
        QMessageBox.information(
            self,
            "Ubicación de datos actualizada",
            "FAMILYFIN usará a partir de ahora la base de datos de:\n"
            f"{new_dir}\n\nVuelve a iniciar sesión para continuar.",
        )
        parent = self.parentWidget()
        while parent is not None and not hasattr(parent, "_on_logout"):
            parent = parent.parentWidget()
        if parent is not None:
            parent._on_logout()
        return True

    def _create_backup(self) -> None:
        self._collect_from_form()
        try:
            self._settings_manager.ensure_dirs(self._settings)
            target_dir = self._settings.backup_folder or self._settings.export_folder or "."
            backup_path = self._settings_manager.backup_all_data(target_dir, user_name=self._user.username)
            QMessageBox.information(self, "Copia de seguridad", f"Se creó la copia de seguridad en:\n{backup_path}")
        except Exception as exc:
            QMessageBox.critical(self, "Error al crear la copia de seguridad", str(exc))

    def _restore_backup(self) -> None:
        backup_path, _ = QFileDialog.getOpenFileName(
            self,
            "Selecciona un respaldo de FAMILYFIN",
            self._settings.backup_folder or ".",
            "Archivo ZIP (*.zip)",
        )
        if not backup_path:
            return
        try:
            ok = self._settings_manager.restore_all_data(backup_path)
            if ok:
                QMessageBox.information(
                    self,
                    "Restauración preparada",
                    "La copia de seguridad es válida y está preparada.\n\n"
                    "Cierra y vuelve a abrir FAMILYFIN para completar la restauración. "
                    "Los datos actuales se guardarán antes en una copia (profin.before-restore.*.db).",
                )
            else:
                QMessageBox.warning(self, "Restauración inválida", "El archivo de backup no es válido para FAMILYFIN.")
        except Exception as exc:
            QMessageBox.critical(self, "Error al restaurar", str(exc))

    def apply_theme(self, theme_key: str) -> None:
        self._theme = theme_key
        self._t = THEMES[theme_key]
        self._apply_theme()

    def _apply_theme(self) -> None:
        t = self._t
        self.setStyleSheet(f"""
            QWidget {{
                background-color: {t["bg_primary"]};
                color: {t["text_primary"]};
                font-family: "Segoe UI";
            }}
            QFrame#dashTopBar {{
                background-color: {t["bg_secondary"]};
                border-bottom: 1px solid {t["border"]};
            }}
            QLabel#dashTitle {{
                color: {t["text_primary"]};
                font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700;
            }}
            QFrame#settingsSidebar {{
```

## `app/gui/transactions_view.py`

```python
"""
app/gui/transactions_view.py
=============================
FAMILYFIN — Transactions View (Fase 4b)

Features:
  - Filterable/sortable table: Fecha | Emisor | Concepto | Importe
                               | Tipo | Categoría | Saldo
  - Inline category assignment via dropdown in Categoría column
  - Filter bar: search text + type filter + date range
  - Pagination for large datasets (100 rows per page)
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import date
from typing   import List, Optional

from PySide6.QtCore    import Qt, QSortFilterProxyModel, QDate
from PySide6.QtGui     import QFont, QColor, QStandardItemModel, QStandardItem
from PySide6.QtWidgets import (
    QWidget, QVBoxLayout, QHBoxLayout, QLabel,
    QPushButton, QFrame, QTableView, QHeaderView,
    QLineEdit, QComboBox, QSizePolicy, QAbstractItemView,
    QDateEdit, QApplication,
)
import qtawesome as qta

from sqlalchemy        import or_
from sqlalchemy.orm    import Session

from app.config      import THEMES
from app.db.models   import (
    Transaction, TransactionType, Category, CategoryLevel, User
)
from app.categorization.category_manager import (
    assign_transaction_category, get_all_categories
)
from app.gui._style_utils import apply_card_shadow


PAGE_SIZE = 100


class TransactionsView(QWidget):

    def __init__(self, user: User, session: Session,
                 theme: str = "light") -> None:
        super().__init__()
        self._user    = user
        self._session = session
        self._theme   = theme
        self._t       = THEMES[theme]
        self._page    = 0
        self._total   = 0
        self._categories: List[Category] = []

        self._build_ui()
        self._apply_theme()
        self._load_categories()
        self.refresh()

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # UI construction
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    def _build_ui(self) -> None:
        root = QVBoxLayout(self)
        root.setContentsMargins(0, 0, 0, 0)
        root.setSpacing(0)

        # Top bar
        root.addWidget(self._make_topbar())

        # Filter bar
        self._filter_bar = self._make_filter_bar()
        root.addWidget(self._filter_bar)

        # Table
        self._table = QTableView()
        self._table.setSelectionBehavior(
            QAbstractItemView.SelectionBehavior.SelectRows
        )
        self._table.setEditTriggers(
            QAbstractItemView.EditTrigger.NoEditTriggers
        )
        self._table.setAlternatingRowColors(True)
        self._table.setShowGrid(False)
        self._table.verticalHeader().setVisible(False)
        self._table.setSortingEnabled(True)
        self._table.horizontalHeader().setStretchLastSection(False)

        self._model = QStandardItemModel()
        self._model.setHorizontalHeaderLabels([
            "Fecha", "Emisor", "Concepto",
            "Importe", "Tipo", "Categoría", "Saldo"
        ])
        self._table.setModel(self._model)

        hdr = self._table.horizontalHeader()
        hdr.setSectionResizeMode(0, QHeaderView.ResizeMode.ResizeToContents)
        hdr.setSectionResizeMode(1, QHeaderView.ResizeMode.ResizeToContents)
        hdr.setSectionResizeMode(2, QHeaderView.ResizeMode.Stretch)
        hdr.setSectionResizeMode(3, QHeaderView.ResizeMode.ResizeToContents)
        hdr.setSectionResizeMode(4, QHeaderView.ResizeMode.ResizeToContents)
        hdr.setSectionResizeMode(5, QHeaderView.ResizeMode.ResizeToContents)
        hdr.setSectionResizeMode(6, QHeaderView.ResizeMode.ResizeToContents)

        self._table.doubleClicked.connect(self._on_row_double_clicked)
        root.addWidget(self._table)

        # Pagination bar
        self._pagination_bar = self._make_pagination_bar()
        root.addWidget(self._pagination_bar)

    def _make_topbar(self) -> QFrame:
        bar = QFrame()
        bar.setObjectName("dashTopBar")
        bar.setFixedHeight(56)
        layout = QHBoxLayout(bar)
        layout.setContentsMargins(24, 0, 24, 0)

        lbl = QLabel("Transacciones")
        lbl.setFont(QFont("Segoe UI", 15, QFont.Weight.Bold))
        lbl.setObjectName("dashTitle")
        layout.addWidget(lbl)

        layout.addStretch()

        self._lbl_count = QLabel("")
        self._lbl_count.setObjectName("txnCount")
        layout.addWidget(self._lbl_count)

        layout.addSpacing(12)

        btn_refresh = QPushButton()
        btn_refresh.setFixedSize(32, 32)
        btn_refresh.setFlat(True)
        btn_refresh.setCursor(Qt.CursorShape.PointingHandCursor)
        btn_refresh.setToolTip("Actualizar — re-aplica reglas y recarga tabla")
        btn_refresh.setIcon(
            qta.icon("mdi.refresh", color=self._t["text_secondary"])
        )
        btn_refresh.clicked.connect(self._refresh_with_rules)
        layout.addWidget(btn_refresh)
        self._btn_refresh_top = btn_refresh

        return bar

    def _make_filter_bar(self) -> QFrame:
        bar = QFrame()
        bar.setObjectName("filterBar")
        bar.setFixedHeight(52)
        layout = QHBoxLayout(bar)
        layout.setContentsMargins(16, 8, 16, 8)
        layout.setSpacing(10)

        # Search
        self._inp_search = QLineEdit()
        self._inp_search.setPlaceholderText("🔍  Buscar por emisor o concepto...")
        self._inp_search.setFixedHeight(34)
        self._inp_search.setObjectName("filterInput")
        self._inp_search.setMinimumWidth(240)
        self._inp_search.textChanged.connect(self._on_filter_changed)
        layout.addWidget(self._inp_search)

        # Type filter
        self._cmb_type = QComboBox()
        self._cmb_type.setFixedHeight(34)
        self._cmb_type.setObjectName("filterCombo")
        self._cmb_type.addItem("Todos los tipos", None)
        self._cmb_type.addItem("Ingresos",   TransactionType.income)
        self._cmb_type.addItem("Gastos",     TransactionType.expense)
        self._cmb_type.addItem("Inversiones",TransactionType.investment)
        self._cmb_type.currentIndexChanged.connect(self._on_filter_changed)
        layout.addWidget(self._cmb_type)

        # Category filter
        self._cmb_cat = QComboBox()
        self._cmb_cat.setFixedHeight(34)
        self._cmb_cat.setObjectName("filterCombo")
        self._cmb_cat.setMinimumWidth(160)
        self._cmb_cat.addItem("Todas las categorías", None)
        self._cmb_cat.addItem("Sin categorizar", -1)
        self._cmb_cat.currentIndexChanged.connect(self._on_filter_changed)
        layout.addWidget(self._cmb_cat)

        layout.addStretch()

        # Clear filters
        btn_clear = QPushButton("Limpiar filtros")
        btn_clear.setFixedHeight(34)
        btn_clear.setObjectName("btnSecondary")
        btn_clear.setCursor(Qt.CursorShape.PointingHandCursor)
        btn_clear.clicked.connect(self._clear_filters)
        layout.addWidget(btn_clear)

        return bar

    def _make_pagination_bar(self) -> QFrame:
        bar = QFrame()
        bar.setObjectName("paginationBar")
        bar.setFixedHeight(44)
        layout = QHBoxLayout(bar)
        layout.setContentsMargins(16, 0, 16, 0)
        layout.setSpacing(8)

        self._btn_prev = QPushButton()
        self._btn_prev.setFixedSize(32, 32)
        self._btn_prev.setFlat(True)
        self._btn_prev.setIcon(
            qta.icon("mdi.chevron-left", color=self._t["text_secondary"])
        )
        self._btn_prev.clicked.connect(self._prev_page)
        layout.addWidget(self._btn_prev)

        self._lbl_page = QLabel("Página 1")
        self._lbl_page.setObjectName("pageLabel")
        layout.addWidget(self._lbl_page)

        self._btn_next = QPushButton()
        self._btn_next.setFixedSize(32, 32)
        self._btn_next.setFlat(True)
        self._btn_next.setIcon(
            qta.icon("mdi.chevron-right", color=self._t["text_secondary"])
        )
        self._btn_next.clicked.connect(self._next_page)
        layout.addWidget(self._btn_next)

        layout.addStretch()
        return bar

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Data loading
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    def _load_categories(self) -> None:
        """Load categories for the inline dropdown."""
        self._categories = get_all_categories(
            self._session, self._user.id, level=CategoryLevel.category
        )
        # Refresh category filter combo
        self._cmb_cat.clear()
        self._cmb_cat.addItem("Todas las categorías", None)
        self._cmb_cat.addItem("Sin categorizar", -1)
        for cat in self._categories:
            self._cmb_cat.addItem(cat.name, cat.id)

    def _refresh_with_rules(self) -> None:
        """
        Re-apply all active categorization rules to uncategorized
        transactions, then reload the table.
        Called by the top-bar refresh button.
        """
        import logging
        _log = logging.getLogger(__name__)

        try:
            from app.db.models import Transaction as TxnModel
            from app.categorization.rules_engine import apply_rules_and_commit

            # overwrite=False only ever fills empty categories, so only the
            # uncategorized rows need to go through the engine — not the
            # whole history on every visit to this tab.
            uncategorized_ids = [
                row.id for row in (
                    self._session.query(TxnModel.id)
                    .filter(
                        TxnModel.user_id == self._user.id,
                        TxnModel.category_id.is_(None),
                    )
                    .all()
                )
            ]

            if uncategorized_ids:
                result = apply_rules_and_commit(
                    self._session,
                    uncategorized_ids,
                    self._user.id,
                    overwrite=False,
                )
                n = len(result.assigned)
                if n:
                    _log.info(
                        "Refresh: %d transacciones auto-categorizadas", n
                    )

        except Exception as exc:
            self._session.rollback()
            _log.warning("Error al re-aplicar reglas en refresh: %s", exc)

        # Always reload the table regardless of rule results
        self.refresh()

    def showEvent(self, event) -> None:
        """
        Called automatically by Qt every time this widget becomes visible
        — including when the user clicks 'Transacciones' in the sidebar.
        Re-applies categorization rules silently and reloads the table.
        """
        super().showEvent(event)
        self._refresh_with_rules()

    def refresh(self) -> None:
        self._page = 0
        self._load_categories()
        self._load_data()

    def _load_data(self) -> None:
        t = self._t
        search_text = self._inp_search.text().strip().lower()
        type_filter = self._cmb_type.currentData()
        cat_filter  = self._cmb_cat.currentData()

        query = (
            self._session.query(Transaction)
            .filter(Transaction.user_id == self._user.id)
        )

        if type_filter is not None:
            query = query.filter(Transaction.type == type_filter)

        if cat_filter == -1:
            query = query.filter(
                Transaction.category_id == None  # noqa: E711
            )
        elif cat_filter is not None:
            query = query.filter(Transaction.category_id == cat_filter)

        if search_text:
            query = query.filter(
                or_(
                    Transaction.issuer_name.ilike(f"%{search_text}%"),
                    Transaction.concept.ilike(f"%{search_text}%"),
                )
            )

        query = query.order_by(
            Transaction.transaction_date.desc(),
            Transaction.id.desc()
        )

        self._total = query.count()
        offset      = self._page * PAGE_SIZE
        transactions = query.offset(offset).limit(PAGE_SIZE).all()

        self._lbl_count.setText(
            f"{self._total} transacciones"
        )
        total_pages = max(1, (self._total + PAGE_SIZE - 1) // PAGE_SIZE)
        self._lbl_page.setText(
            f"Página {self._page + 1} de {total_pages}"
        )
        self._btn_prev.setEnabled(self._page > 0)
        self._btn_next.setEnabled(
            (self._page + 1) * PAGE_SIZE < self._total
        )

        # Build category lookup
        cat_map = {c.id: c.name for c in self._categories}
        type_labels = {
            TransactionType.income:     "Ingreso",
            TransactionType.expense:    "Gasto",
            TransactionType.investment: "Inversión",
            TransactionType.unknown:    "—",
        }

        self._model.removeRows(0, self._model.rowCount())
        self._txn_ids: List[int] = []

        for txn in transactions:
            self._txn_ids.append(txn.id)

            amount  = txn.amount or 0.0
            balance = txn.running_balance or 0.0

            # Fecha
            item_date = QStandardItem(
                str(txn.transaction_date) if txn.transaction_date else ""
            )

            # Emisor
            item_issuer = QStandardItem(
                (txn.issuer_name or "")[:40]
            )

            # Concepto
            item_concept = QStandardItem(
                (txn.concept or "")[:80]
            )

            # Importe
            amt_str = self._fmt_amount(amount)
            item_amount = QStandardItem(amt_str)
            item_amount.setTextAlignment(
                Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignRight |
                Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignVCenter
            )
            clr = t["income"] if amount >= 0 else t["expense"]
            item_amount.setForeground(QColor(clr))

            # Tipo
            item_type = QStandardItem(
                type_labels.get(txn.type, "—")
            )

            # Categoría
            cat_name = cat_map.get(txn.category_id, "Sin categorizar")
            item_cat = QStandardItem(cat_name)
            if txn.category_id is None:
                item_cat.setForeground(QColor(t["warning"]))

            # Saldo
            item_balance = QStandardItem(
                self._fmt_amount(balance)
            )
            item_balance.setTextAlignment(
                Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignRight |
                Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignVCenter
            )

            row = [item_date, item_issuer, item_concept,
                   item_amount, item_type, item_cat, item_balance]
            for item in row:
                item.setEditable(False)
            self._model.appendRow(row)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Category assignment dialog (double-click on row)
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    def _on_row_double_clicked(self, index) -> None:
        row = index.row()
        if row >= len(self._txn_ids):
            return
        txn_id = self._txn_ids[row]
        self._open_category_dialog(txn_id, row)

    def _open_category_dialog(self, txn_id: int, row: int) -> None:
        from PySide6.QtWidgets import QDialog, QDialogButtonBox

        t   = self._t
        txn = self._session.get(Transaction, txn_id)
        if txn is None:
            return

        dlg = QDialog(self)
        dlg.setWindowTitle("Asignar categoría")
        dlg.setFixedWidth(400)
        dlg.setModal(True)

        layout = QVBoxLayout(dlg)
        layout.setContentsMargins(24, 24, 24, 24)
        layout.setSpacing(14)

        # Transaction info
        lbl_info = QLabel(
            f"<b>{txn.issuer_name or txn.concept or 'Transacción'}</b><br>"
            f"<small>{txn.transaction_date} · "
            f"{self._fmt_amount(txn.amount or 0)}</small>"
        )
        lbl_info.setWordWrap(True)
        lbl_info.setStyleSheet(
            f"color: {t['text_primary']}; font-size: 13px;"
        )
        layout.addWidget(lbl_info)

        sep = QFrame()
        sep.setFrameShape(QFrame.Shape.HLine)
        sep.setStyleSheet(f"color: {t['border']};")
        layout.addWidget(sep)

        lbl_cat = QLabel("Categoría:")
        lbl_cat.setStyleSheet(
            f"font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; color: {t['text_secondary']};"
        )
        layout.addWidget(lbl_cat)

        cmb = QComboBox()
        cmb.setFixedHeight(38)
        cmb.addItem("Sin categorizar", None)
        current_idx = 0
        for i, cat in enumerate(self._categories, start=1):
            cmb.addItem(cat.name, cat.id)
            if cat.id == txn.category_id:
                current_idx = i
        cmb.setCurrentIndex(current_idx)
        cmb.setStyleSheet(f"""
            QComboBox {{
                background-color: {t["bg_primary"]};
                border: 1.5px solid {t["border"]};
                border-radius: 8px;
                padding: 6px 12px;
                color: {t["text_primary"]};
                font-size: 13px;
            }}
            QComboBox:focus {{ border-color: {t["accent"]}; }}
        """)
        layout.addWidget(cmb)

        btn_box = QDialogButtonBox(
            QDialogButtonBox.StandardButton.Ok |
            QDialogButtonBox.StandardButton.Cancel
        )
        btn_box.button(QDialogButtonBox.StandardButton.Ok).setText(
            "Guardar"
        )
        btn_box.button(QDialogButtonBox.StandardButton.Ok).setObjectName(
            "btnPrimary"
        )
        btn_box.accepted.connect(dlg.accept)
        btn_box.rejected.connect(dlg.reject)
        layout.addWidget(btn_box)

        dlg.setStyleSheet(f"""
            QDialog {{ background-color: {t["bg_secondary"]}; }}
            QPushButton#btnPrimary {{
                background-color: {t["accent"]}; color: #FFFFFF;
                border: none; border-radius: 6px;
                font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600;
                padding: 6px 16px;
            }}
        """)

        if dlg.exec() == QDialog.DialogCode.Accepted:
            new_cat_id = cmb.currentData()
            assign_transaction_category(
                self._session, txn_id, new_cat_id
            )
            # Update model cell directly (no full reload)
            cat_name = next(
                (c.name for c in self._categories
                 if c.id == new_cat_id),
                "Sin categorizar"
            )
            self._model.item(row, 5).setText(cat_name)
            if new_cat_id is None:
                self._model.item(row, 5).setForeground(
                    QColor(t["warning"])
                )
            else:
                self._model.item(row, 5).setForeground(
                    QColor(t["text_primary"])
                )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Filter / pagination slots
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    def _on_filter_changed(self) -> None:
        self._page = 0
        self._load_data()

    def _clear_filters(self) -> None:
        self._inp_search.clear()
        self._cmb_type.setCurrentIndex(0)
        self._cmb_cat.setCurrentIndex(0)
        self._page = 0
        self._load_data()

    def _prev_page(self) -> None:
        if self._page > 0:
            self._page -= 1
            self._load_data()

    def _next_page(self) -> None:
        if (self._page + 1) * PAGE_SIZE < self._total:
            self._page += 1
            self._load_data()

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Helpers
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    @staticmethod
    def _fmt_amount(value: float) -> str:
        sign = "+" if value >= 0 else ""
        return (
            f"{sign}{abs(value):,.2f} €"
            .replace(",", "X").replace(".", ",").replace("X", ".")
        )

    def apply_theme(self, theme_key: str) -> None:
        self._theme = theme_key
        self._t = THEMES[theme_key]
        self._apply_theme()

    def _apply_theme(self) -> None:
        t = self._t
        is_dark = self._theme == "dark"
        selection_bg = (
            f"background-color: {t['accent']}; color: #FFFFFF;"
            if is_dark else
            f"background: qlineargradient(x1:0, y1:0, x2:1, y2:0, "
            f"stop:0 {t['selection_grad_start']}, stop:1 {t['selection_grad_end']}); "
            f"color: {t['selection_text']};"
        )
        selection_hover = (
            f"background-color: {t['accent_hover']}; color: #FFFFFF;"
            if is_dark else
            f"background: qlineargradient(x1:0, y1:0, x2:1, y2:0, "
            f"stop:0 {t['selection_hover_start']}, stop:1 {t['selection_hover_end']}); "
            f"color: {t['selection_text']};"
        )
        self.setStyleSheet(f"""
            QFrame#dashTopBar {{
                background-color: {t["bg_secondary"]};
                border-bottom: 1px solid {t["border"]};
            }}
            QLabel#dashTitle {{
                color: {t["text_primary"]};
                font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700;
            }}
            QLabel#txnCount {{
                color: {t["text_secondary"]};
                font-size: 12px;
            }}
            QFrame#filterBar {{
                background-color: {t["bg_primary"]};
                border-bottom: 1px solid {t["border"]};
            }}
            QLineEdit#filterInput {{
                background-color: {t["bg_secondary"]};
                border: 1px solid {t["border"]};
                border-radius: 6px;
                padding: 4px 10px;
                color: {t["text_primary"]};
                font-size: 13px;
            }}
            QLineEdit#filterInput:focus {{
                border-color: {t["accent"]};
            }}
            QComboBox#filterCombo {{
                background-color: {t["bg_secondary"]};
                border: 1px solid {t["border"]};
                border-radius: 6px;
                padding: 4px 10px;
                color: {t["text_primary"]};
                font-size: 13px;
            }}
            QPushButton#btnSecondary {{
                background-color: transparent;
                color: {t["text_secondary"]};
                border: 1px solid {t["border"]};
                border-radius: 6px;
                font-size: 12px;
                padding: 0 12px;
            }}
            QPushButton#btnSecondary:hover {{
                background-color: {t["bg_hover"]};
            }}
            QTableView {{
                background-color: {t["bg_secondary"]};
                border: none;
                color: {t["text_primary"]};
                font-size: 12px;
                alternate-background-color: {t["bg_primary"]};
            }}
            QTableView::item {{
                padding: 6px 8px;
                border-bottom: 1px solid {t["border"]};
            }}
            QTableView::item:hover {{
                background-color: {t["bg_hover"]};
                color: {t["text_primary"]};
            }}
            QTableView::item:selected {{
                {selection_bg}
            }}
            QTableView::item:selected:hover {{
                {selection_hover}
            }}
            QHeaderView::section {{
                background-color: {t["bg_primary"]};
                color: {t["text_secondary"]};
                font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700;
                padding: 6px 8px; border: none;
                border-bottom: 2px solid {t["border"]};
                text-transform: uppercase;
            }}
            QFrame#paginationBar {{
                background-color: {t["bg_secondary"]};
                border-top: 1px solid {t["border"]};
            }}
            QLabel#pageLabel {{
                color: {t["text_secondary"]};
                font-size: 12px;
            }}
        """)
        apply_card_shadow(self._filter_bar, t, blur_radius=12, y_offset=2)
        apply_card_shadow(self._pagination_bar, t, blur_radius=12, y_offset=-2)
```
