## `app/gui/investment_dialogs.py`

```python
"""
app/gui/investment_dialogs.py
=============================
FAMILYFIN — Dialogs of the Inversiones view.

SecuritySearchDialog
    Searches the market-data provider and adds the chosen security to the
    shared catalogue. Search and the one-off "security info" call run in a
    background thread; the database is touched only on the GUI thread.

TransactionDialog
    Create or edit one operation (Compra / Venta / Dividendo / Split).
    * The EUR total is pre-filled with an estimate (shares × price ÷ FX of
      that day ± fees) until the user types their own figure — the exact
      amount on the broker statement is what the tax return uses.
    * The close of the trade date is offered as the price ("Usar").
    * For a sale, the shares held on that date are shown ("Vender todas").
    * Saving goes through ledger.save_transaction, so an operation that
      would make the ledger impossible is rejected in the dialog itself.
    Market data comes from the local cache first; when the cache has no
    close/FX for the date, one small provider call fills the gap.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import date, timedelta
from typing import Dict, Optional, Tuple

import qtawesome as qta
from PySide6.QtCore import QDate, QLocale, Qt, QTimer
from PySide6.QtWidgets import (
    QAbstractItemView,
    QComboBox,
    QDateEdit,
    QDialog,
    QDoubleSpinBox,
    QFormLayout,
    QHBoxLayout,
    QHeaderView,
    QLabel,
    QLineEdit,
    QPushButton,
    QTableWidget,
    QTableWidgetItem,
    QVBoxLayout,
    QWidget,
)
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from app.db.models import AssetType, InvestmentKind, InvestmentTransaction, Security
from app.gui._background import BackgroundRunner
from app.gui._format import fmt_date, fmt_money, fmt_number, fmt_quantity
from app.investments.ledger import (
    KIND_LABELS,
    TransactionDraft,
    estimate_amount_eur,
    known_brokers,
    picker_securities,
    save_transaction,
)
from app.investments.market_data import (
    MarketDataError,
    MarketDataProvider,
    fx_pair,
    fx_symbol,
)
from app.investments.portfolio import LedgerError, build_positions, split_factor_after
from app.investments.prices import close_on, fx_rate, security_from_info

ASSET_LABELS = {AssetType.stock: "Acción", AssetType.etf: "ETF", AssetType.fund: "Fondo"}

# A cached close/FX older than this before the trade date is not trusted
# for the estimate; the provider is asked instead.
_MAX_CACHE_GAP = timedelta(days=5)


def dialog_stylesheet(t: dict) -> str:
    return f"""
        QDialog {{ background-color: {t["bg_secondary"]}; }}
        QLabel {{ color: {t["text_primary"]}; font-size: 13px; background: transparent; }}
        QLabel#dlgTitle {{ font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700; }}
        QLabel#dlgHint {{ color: {t["text_secondary"]}; font-size: 12px; }}
        QLabel#dlgError {{ color: {t["expense"]}; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; }}
        QLineEdit, QComboBox, QDateEdit, QDoubleSpinBox {{
            background-color: {t["bg_primary"]};
            border: 1px solid {t["border"]};
            border-radius: 6px;
            padding: 5px 8px;
            color: {t["text_primary"]};
            font-size: 13px;
            min-height: 22px;
        }}
        QLineEdit:focus, QComboBox:focus, QDateEdit:focus, QDoubleSpinBox:focus {{
            border-color: {t["accent"]};
        }}
        QPushButton#btnPrimary {{
            background-color: {t["accent"]}; color: #FFFFFF;
            border: none; border-radius: 6px;
            font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; padding: 7px 18px;
        }}
        QPushButton#btnPrimary:hover {{ background-color: {t["accent_hover"]}; }}
        QPushButton#btnPrimary:disabled {{ background-color: {t["border_strong"]}; }}
        QPushButton#btnSecondary, QPushButton#btnLink {{
            background-color: transparent; color: {t["text_secondary"]};
            border: 1px solid {t["border"]}; border-radius: 6px;
            font-size: 12px; padding: 5px 12px;
        }}
        QPushButton#btnLink {{ color: {t["accent"]}; border: none; padding: 2px 6px; }}
        QPushButton#btnSecondary:hover, QPushButton#btnLink:hover {{
            background-color: {t["bg_hover"]};
        }}
        QTableWidget {{
            background-color: {t["bg_secondary"]};
            border: 1px solid {t["border"]}; border-radius: 6px;
            color: {t["text_primary"]}; font-size: 12px;
            alternate-background-color: {t["bg_primary"]};
        }}
        QTableWidget::item:selected {{ background-color: {t["accent"]}; color: #FFFFFF; }}
        QHeaderView::section {{
            background-color: {t["bg_primary"]}; color: {t["text_secondary"]};
            font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; padding: 5px 8px; border: none;
            border-bottom: 2px solid {t["border"]};
        }}
    """


def _qdate(value: date) -> QDate:
    return QDate(value.year, value.month, value.day)


def _pydate(value: QDate) -> date:
    return date(value.year(), value.month(), value.day())


_ES = QLocale(QLocale.Language.Spanish, QLocale.Country.Spain)


class _NumberBox(QDoubleSpinBox):
    """Spanish decimal comma; shares/prices drop trailing zeros (2 → "2")."""

    def __init__(self, decimals: int, trim: bool) -> None:
        super().__init__()
        self._trim = trim
        self.setLocale(_ES)
        self.setDecimals(decimals)

    def textFromValue(self, value: float) -> str:
        text = _ES.toString(value, "f", self.decimals())
        if self._trim and "," in text:
            text = text.rstrip("0").rstrip(",")
        return text


def _spin(decimals: int, suffix: str = "", maximum: float = 1e12,
          trim: bool = False) -> QDoubleSpinBox:
    spin = _NumberBox(decimals, trim)
    spin.setRange(0.0, maximum)
    spin.setSuffix(suffix)
    spin.setGroupSeparatorShown(True)
    spin.setButtonSymbols(QDoubleSpinBox.ButtonSymbols.NoButtons)
    spin.setAlignment(Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignRight)
    spin.setFixedWidth(190)
    return spin


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Security search
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
class SecuritySearchDialog(QDialog):
    """Find a security with the provider and add it to the catalogue."""

    def __init__(self, session: Session, provider: MarketDataProvider,
                 theme: dict, initial_text: str = "", parent: Optional[QWidget] = None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self._session = session
        self._provider = provider
        self._t = theme
        self._results = []
        self.security: Optional[Security] = None
        self._runner = BackgroundRunner(self)
        self._debounce = QTimer(self)
        self._debounce.setSingleShot(True)
        self._debounce.setInterval(400)
        self._debounce.timeout.connect(self._search)

        self.setWindowTitle("Buscar valor")
        self.setModal(True)
        self.resize(620, 460)
        self._build()
        self.setStyleSheet(dialog_stylesheet(theme))
        if initial_text:
            self._inp.setText(initial_text)
            self._search()

    def _build(self) -> None:
        layout = QVBoxLayout(self)
        layout.setContentsMargins(22, 20, 22, 18)
        layout.setSpacing(10)

        title = QLabel("Buscar acción, ETF o fondo")
        title.setObjectName("dlgTitle")
        layout.addWidget(title)
        hint = QLabel(
            "Escribe el ticker, el nombre o el ISIN. Fíjate en la bolsa: la misma "
            "empresa cotiza en varias (p. ej. AMZN en NASDAQ en USD, AMZ.DE en Xetra en EUR); "
            "elige la bolsa en la que compraste."
        )
        hint.setObjectName("dlgHint")
        hint.setWordWrap(True)
        layout.addWidget(hint)

        row = QHBoxLayout()
        self._inp = QLineEdit()
        self._inp.setPlaceholderText("p. ej. Siemens Energy, GEV, Boreas…")
        self._inp.textChanged.connect(self._on_text_changed)
        self._inp.returnPressed.connect(self._search)
        row.addWidget(self._inp, 1)
        btn = QPushButton(" Buscar")
        btn.setObjectName("btnSecondary")
        btn.setIcon(qta.icon("mdi.magnify", color=self._t["text_secondary"]))
        btn.clicked.connect(self._search)
        row.addWidget(btn)
        layout.addLayout(row)

        self._table = QTableWidget(0, 4)
        self._table.setHorizontalHeaderLabels(["Símbolo", "Nombre", "Bolsa", "Tipo"])
        self._table.setSelectionBehavior(QAbstractItemView.SelectionBehavior.SelectRows)
        self._table.setSelectionMode(QAbstractItemView.SelectionMode.SingleSelection)
        self._table.setEditTriggers(QAbstractItemView.EditTrigger.NoEditTriggers)
        self._table.verticalHeader().setVisible(False)
        self._table.setAlternatingRowColors(True)
        self._table.setShowGrid(False)
        header = self._table.horizontalHeader()
        header.setSectionResizeMode(0, QHeaderView.ResizeMode.ResizeToContents)
        header.setSectionResizeMode(1, QHeaderView.ResizeMode.Stretch)
        header.setSectionResizeMode(2, QHeaderView.ResizeMode.ResizeToContents)
        header.setSectionResizeMode(3, QHeaderView.ResizeMode.ResizeToContents)
        self._table.itemSelectionChanged.connect(self._update_buttons)
        self._table.doubleClicked.connect(lambda _: self._add())
        layout.addWidget(self._table, 1)

        form = QFormLayout()
        self._inp_isin = QLineEdit()
        self._inp_isin.setPlaceholderText("Opcional (12 caracteres)")
        self._inp_isin.setMaxLength(12)
        form.addRow("ISIN:", self._inp_isin)
        layout.addLayout(form)

        self._lbl_status = QLabel("")
        self._lbl_status.setObjectName("dlgHint")
        self._lbl_status.setWordWrap(True)
        layout.addWidget(self._lbl_status)

        buttons = QHBoxLayout()
        buttons.addStretch()
        cancel = QPushButton("Cancelar")
        cancel.setObjectName("btnSecondary")
        cancel.clicked.connect(self.reject)
        buttons.addWidget(cancel)
        self._btn_add = QPushButton("Añadir valor")
        self._btn_add.setObjectName("btnPrimary")
        self._btn_add.clicked.connect(self._add)
        buttons.addWidget(self._btn_add)
        layout.addLayout(buttons)
        self._update_buttons()

    def _set_status(self, text: str, error: bool = False) -> None:
        self._lbl_status.setObjectName("dlgError" if error else "dlgHint")
        self._lbl_status.setStyleSheet("")      # re-evaluate the object-name rule
        self._lbl_status.setText(text)

    def _on_text_changed(self, text: str) -> None:
        if len(text.strip()) >= 2:
            self._debounce.start()

    def _search(self) -> None:
        self._debounce.stop()
        text = self._inp.text().strip()
        if not text:
            return
        self._set_status("Buscando…")
        provider = self._provider
        self._runner.run(lambda: provider.search(text), self._on_results, latest_only=True)

    def _on_results(self, results, error) -> None:
        if error is not None:
            self._set_status(str(error) if isinstance(error, MarketDataError)
                             else f"Error en la búsqueda: {error}", error=True)
            return
        self._results = list(results or [])
        self._table.setRowCount(len(self._results))
        for row, result in enumerate(self._results):
            values = [result.symbol, result.name, result.exchange,
                      ASSET_LABELS.get(result.asset_type, "")]
            for col, value in enumerate(values):
                self._table.setItem(row, col, QTableWidgetItem(value))
        if self._results:
            self._table.selectRow(0)
            self._set_status(f"{len(self._results)} resultados.")
        else:
            self._set_status("Sin resultados. Prueba con otro nombre o con el ticker.")
        self._update_buttons()

    def _update_buttons(self) -> None:
        self._btn_add.setEnabled(bool(self._table.selectedItems()) and not self._runner.busy)

    def _add(self) -> None:
        rows = self._table.selectionModel().selectedRows()
        if not rows:
            return
        result = self._results[rows[0].row()]
        existing = (self._session.query(Security)
                    .filter(Security.symbol == result.symbol.upper()).one_or_none())
        if existing is not None:
            self._finish(existing)
            return
        self._set_status(f"Obteniendo los datos de {result.symbol}…")
        self._btn_add.setEnabled(False)
        provider = self._provider
        self._runner.run(lambda: provider.security_info(result.symbol), self._on_info)

    def _on_info(self, info, error) -> None:
        self._update_buttons()
        if error is not None:
            self._set_status(str(error), error=True)
            return
        try:
            security = security_from_info(self._session, info, self._inp_isin.text().strip() or None)
            self._session.commit()
        except Exception as exc:
            self._session.rollback()
            self._set_status(f"No se pudo guardar el valor: {exc}", error=True)
            return
        self._finish(security)

    def _finish(self, security: Security) -> None:
        self.security = security
        self.accept()

    def done(self, result: int) -> None:
        self._runner.shutdown()
        super().done(result)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Operation entry / edit
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
class TransactionDialog(QDialog):
    """Create or edit one operation of the current user."""

    KINDS = (InvestmentKind.buy, InvestmentKind.sell, InvestmentKind.dividend,
             InvestmentKind.split)

    def __init__(
        self,
        session: Session,
        user_id: int,
        provider: MarketDataProvider,
        theme: dict,
        transaction: Optional[InvestmentTransaction] = None,
        default_security_id: Optional[int] = None,
        default_kind: InvestmentKind = InvestmentKind.buy,
        prefill: Optional[dict] = None,
        parent: Optional[QWidget] = None,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(parent)
        self._session = session
        self._user_id = user_id
        self._provider = provider
        self._t = theme
        self._editing = transaction
        self._runner = BackgroundRunner(self)
        self._amount_auto = transaction is None
        self._setting_amount = False
        # (symbol, trade date) → (close date, close, fx rate) fetched from the provider
        self._market: Dict[Tuple[str, date], Tuple[Optional[date], Optional[float], Optional[float]]] = {}
        self._pending_lookup: Optional[Tuple[str, date]] = None
        self._suggested_close: Optional[float] = None
        self._held: Optional[float] = None
        self.saved: Optional[InvestmentTransaction] = None
        self.created_security = False

        self.setWindowTitle("Editar operación" if transaction else "Nueva operación")
        self.setModal(True)
        self.setMinimumWidth(560)
        self._build()
        self.setStyleSheet(dialog_stylesheet(theme))
        self._load(transaction, default_security_id, default_kind)
        if transaction is None and prefill:
            self._apply_prefill(prefill)

    # -- construction ------------------------------------------------------
    def _build(self) -> None:
        t = self._t
        layout = QVBoxLayout(self)
        layout.setContentsMargins(24, 20, 24, 18)
        layout.setSpacing(12)

        title = QLabel(self.windowTitle())
        title.setObjectName("dlgTitle")
        layout.addWidget(title)

        self._lbl_prefill = QLabel("")
        self._lbl_prefill.setObjectName("dlgHint")
        self._lbl_prefill.setWordWrap(True)
        self._lbl_prefill.setVisible(False)
        layout.addWidget(self._lbl_prefill)

        form = QFormLayout()
        form.setHorizontalSpacing(14)
        form.setVerticalSpacing(9)
        form.setLabelAlignment(Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignRight | Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignVCenter)
        self._form = form

        self._cmb_kind = QComboBox()
        for kind in self.KINDS:
            self._cmb_kind.addItem(KIND_LABELS[kind], kind)
        self._cmb_kind.currentIndexChanged.connect(self._on_kind_changed)
        form.addRow("Tipo:", self._cmb_kind)

        security_row = QHBoxLayout()
        self._cmb_security = QComboBox()
        self._cmb_security.setMinimumWidth(300)
        self._cmb_security.currentIndexChanged.connect(self._on_security_changed)
        security_row.addWidget(self._cmb_security, 1)
        btn_search = QPushButton(" Buscar…")
        btn_search.setObjectName("btnSecondary")
        btn_search.setIcon(qta.icon("mdi.magnify", color=t["text_secondary"]))
        btn_search.setToolTip("Buscar un valor nuevo en Yahoo Finance")
        btn_search.clicked.connect(self._open_search)
        security_row.addWidget(btn_search)
        form.addRow("Valor:", security_row)

        self._lbl_security = QLabel("")
        self._lbl_security.setObjectName("dlgHint")
        form.addRow("", self._lbl_security)

        self._date = QDateEdit()
        self._date.setCalendarPopup(True)
        self._date.setDisplayFormat("dd/MM/yyyy")
        self._date.setMaximumDate(_qdate(date.today()))
        self._date.dateChanged.connect(self._on_inputs_changed)
        form.addRow("Fecha:", self._date)

        qty_row = QHBoxLayout()
        self._qty = _spin(6, trim=True)
        self._qty.valueChanged.connect(self._on_inputs_changed)
        qty_row.addWidget(self._qty)
        self._lbl_held = QLabel("")
        self._lbl_held.setObjectName("dlgHint")
        qty_row.addWidget(self._lbl_held)
        self._btn_all = QPushButton("Vender todas")
        self._btn_all.setObjectName("btnLink")
        self._btn_all.clicked.connect(self._sell_all)
        qty_row.addWidget(self._btn_all)
        qty_row.addStretch()
        form.addRow("Nº de acciones:", qty_row)

        price_row = QHBoxLayout()
        self._price = _spin(4, trim=True)
        self._price.valueChanged.connect(self._on_inputs_changed)
        price_row.addWidget(self._price)
        self._lbl_close = QLabel("")
        self._lbl_close.setObjectName("dlgHint")
        self._lbl_close.setMinimumWidth(0)
        price_row.addWidget(self._lbl_close)
        self._btn_use_close = QPushButton("Usar")
        self._btn_use_close.setObjectName("btnLink")
        self._btn_use_close.clicked.connect(self._use_close)
        price_row.addWidget(self._btn_use_close)
        price_row.addStretch()
        form.addRow("Precio por acción:", price_row)

        self._fees = _spin(2, " €")
        self._fees.valueChanged.connect(self._on_inputs_changed)
        form.addRow("Comisiones:", self._fees)

        self._ratio = _spin(4, maximum=1e6, trim=True)
        form.addRow("Acciones nuevas por\ncada acción antigua:", self._ratio)

        amount_row = QHBoxLayout()
        self._amount = _spin(2, " €")
        self._amount.valueChanged.connect(self._on_amount_edited)
        amount_row.addWidget(self._amount)
        self._btn_recalc = QPushButton("Recalcular")
        self._btn_recalc.setObjectName("btnLink")
        self._btn_recalc.setToolTip("Volver al importe estimado")
        self._btn_recalc.clicked.connect(self._recalculate)
        amount_row.addWidget(self._btn_recalc)
        amount_row.addStretch()
        self._lbl_amount = QLabel("Importe total (EUR):")
        form.addRow(self._lbl_amount, amount_row)

        self._lbl_estimate = QLabel("")
        self._lbl_estimate.setObjectName("dlgHint")
        self._lbl_estimate.setWordWrap(True)
        form.addRow("", self._lbl_estimate)

        self._withheld = _spin(2, " €")
        form.addRow("Retención en origen:", self._withheld)

        self._cash_paid = _spin(2, " €")
        form.addRow("Pagado de tu bolsillo:", self._cash_paid)

        self._cmb_broker = QComboBox()
        self._cmb_broker.setEditable(True)
        self._cmb_broker.setInsertPolicy(QComboBox.InsertPolicy.NoInsert)
        form.addRow("Bróker:", self._cmb_broker)

        self._notes = QLineEdit()
        self._notes.setPlaceholderText("Opcional")
        form.addRow("Notas:", self._notes)
        layout.addLayout(form)

        self._lbl_error = QLabel("")
        self._lbl_error.setObjectName("dlgError")
        self._lbl_error.setWordWrap(True)
        self._lbl_error.setVisible(False)
        layout.addWidget(self._lbl_error)

        buttons = QHBoxLayout()
        buttons.addStretch()
        cancel = QPushButton("Cancelar")
        cancel.setObjectName("btnSecondary")
        cancel.clicked.connect(self.reject)
        buttons.addWidget(cancel)
        self._btn_save = QPushButton("Guardar")
        self._btn_save.setObjectName("btnPrimary")
        self._btn_save.setDefault(True)
        self._btn_save.clicked.connect(self._save)
        buttons.addWidget(self._btn_save)
        layout.addLayout(buttons)

    def _load(self, txn, default_security_id, default_kind) -> None:
        if txn is not None and InvestmentKind(txn.kind) == InvestmentKind.grant:
            self._cmb_kind.addItem(KIND_LABELS[InvestmentKind.grant], InvestmentKind.grant)
        self._reload_securities(txn.security_id if txn else default_security_id)
        for broker in known_brokers(self._session, self._user_id):
            self._cmb_broker.addItem(broker)

        if txn is None:
            self._select_kind(default_kind)
            self._date.setDate(_qdate(date.today()))
            self._cmb_broker.setCurrentIndex(0)
            self._on_kind_changed()
            return

        self._select_kind(InvestmentKind(txn.kind))
        self._date.setDate(_qdate(txn.trade_date))
        self._qty.setValue(txn.quantity or 0.0)
        self._price.setValue(txn.price or 0.0)
        self._fees.setValue(txn.fees_eur or 0.0)
        self._ratio.setValue(txn.split_ratio or 0.0)
        self._withheld.setValue(txn.tax_withheld_eur or 0.0)
        self._cash_paid.setValue(txn.cash_paid_eur or 0.0)
        self._set_amount(txn.amount_eur or 0.0)
        self._cmb_broker.setCurrentText(txn.broker)
        self._notes.setText(txn.notes or "")
        self._on_kind_changed()

    def _apply_prefill(self, prefill: dict) -> None:
        """Values proposed by the app (e.g. a dividend detected on Yahoo)."""
        if prefill.get("trade_date"):
            self._date.setDate(_qdate(prefill["trade_date"]))
        if prefill.get("split_ratio"):
            self._ratio.setValue(prefill["split_ratio"])
        if prefill.get("amount_eur") is not None:
            self._amount_auto = False
            self._set_amount(prefill["amount_eur"])
        if prefill.get("notes"):
            self._notes.setText(prefill["notes"])
        if prefill.get("hint"):
            self._lbl_prefill.setText(prefill["hint"])
            self._lbl_prefill.setVisible(True)

    def _select_kind(self, kind: InvestmentKind) -> None:
        index = self._cmb_kind.findData(kind)
        self._cmb_kind.setCurrentIndex(max(index, 0))

    def _reload_securities(self, select_id: Optional[int]) -> None:
        self._cmb_security.blockSignals(True)
        self._cmb_security.clear()
        self._cmb_security.addItem("Selecciona un valor…", None)
        for security in picker_securities(self._session, self._user_id):
            self._cmb_security.addItem(f"{security.name}  ·  {security.symbol}", security.id)
        index = self._cmb_security.findData(select_id) if select_id else 0
        self._cmb_security.setCurrentIndex(max(index, 0))
        self._cmb_security.blockSignals(False)
        self._on_security_changed()

    # -- state helpers ---------------------------------------------------
    def _kind(self) -> InvestmentKind:
        return self._cmb_kind.currentData()

    def _security(self) -> Optional[Security]:
        security_id = self._cmb_security.currentData()
        return self._session.get(Security, security_id) if security_id else None

    def _trade_date(self) -> date:
        return _pydate(self._date.date())

    def _set_amount(self, value: float) -> None:
        self._setting_amount = True
        self._amount.setValue(value)
        self._setting_amount = False

    def _show_error(self, text: str) -> None:
        self._lbl_error.setText(text)
        self._lbl_error.setVisible(bool(text))

    # -- reactions ---------------------------------------------------------
    def _on_kind_changed(self, *_args) -> None:
        kind = self._kind()
        trade = kind in (InvestmentKind.buy, InvestmentKind.sell, InvestmentKind.grant)
        rows = {
            self._qty: trade, self._price: trade, self._fees: trade,
            self._ratio: kind == InvestmentKind.split,
            self._amount: kind != InvestmentKind.split,
            self._lbl_estimate: trade,
            self._withheld: kind == InvestmentKind.dividend,
            self._cash_paid: kind == InvestmentKind.grant,
        }
        for widget, visible in rows.items():
            self._set_row_visible(widget, visible)
        self._lbl_amount.setText({
            InvestmentKind.buy: "Importe total cargado (EUR):",
            InvestmentKind.sell: "Importe neto recibido (EUR):",
            InvestmentKind.dividend: "Dividendo neto recibido (EUR):",
            InvestmentKind.grant: "Valor fiscal al recibirlas (EUR):",
        }.get(kind, "Importe (EUR):"))
        self._on_inputs_changed()

    def _set_row_visible(self, widget: QWidget, visible: bool) -> None:
        for row in range(self._form.rowCount()):
            field = self._form.itemAt(row, QFormLayout.ItemRole.FieldRole)
            if field is None:
                continue
            item_widget = field.widget()
            item_layout = field.layout()
            contains = item_widget is widget or (
                item_layout is not None and any(
                    item_layout.itemAt(i).widget() is widget
                    for i in range(item_layout.count())
                )
            )
            if contains:
                self._form.setRowVisible(row, visible)
                return

    def _on_security_changed(self, *_args) -> None:
        security = self._security()
        if security is None:
            self._lbl_security.setText("")
            self._price.setSuffix("")
        else:
            parts = [ASSET_LABELS.get(AssetType(security.asset_type), ""),
                     security.exchange or "", f"cotiza en {security.currency}"]
            if security.isin:
                parts.append(f"ISIN {security.isin}")
            self._lbl_security.setText("  ·  ".join(p for p in parts if p))
            self._price.setSuffix(f" {security.currency}")
            if self._editing is None:
                last_broker = self._last_broker(security.id)
                if last_broker:
                    self._cmb_broker.setCurrentText(last_broker)
        self._on_inputs_changed()

    def _last_broker(self, security_id: int) -> Optional[str]:
        row = (self._session.query(InvestmentTransaction.broker)
               .filter(InvestmentTransaction.user_id == self._user_id,
                       InvestmentTransaction.security_id == security_id)
               .order_by(InvestmentTransaction.trade_date.desc()).first())
        return row[0] if row else None

    def _on_amount_edited(self, *_args) -> None:
        if not self._setting_amount:
            self._amount_auto = False
            self._update_estimate_label()

    def _recalculate(self) -> None:
        self._amount_auto = True
        self._on_inputs_changed()

    def _on_inputs_changed(self, *_args) -> None:
        self._show_error("")
        self._update_held()
        self._update_market_hints()
        self._update_estimate_label()

    # -- held shares (sales) ---------------------------------------------
    def _update_held(self) -> None:
        security = self._security()
        is_sell = self._kind() == InvestmentKind.sell
        self._held = None
        if security is not None and is_sell:
            day = self._trade_date()
            rows = [t for t in (self._session.query(InvestmentTransaction)
                                .filter(InvestmentTransaction.user_id == self._user_id,
                                        InvestmentTransaction.security_id == security.id,
                                        InvestmentTransaction.trade_date <= day))
                    if self._editing is None or t.id != self._editing.id]
            try:
                position = build_positions(rows).get(security.id)
                self._held = position.quantity if position else 0.0
            except LedgerError:
                self._held = None
        self._lbl_held.setText(
            f"Tienes {fmt_quantity(self._held)} el {fmt_date(self._trade_date())}"
            if self._held is not None else "")
        self._lbl_held.setVisible(self._held is not None)
        self._btn_all.setVisible(bool(self._held))

    def _sell_all(self) -> None:
        if self._held:
            self._qty.setValue(self._held)

    # -- market data (close of the day, FX) ------------------------------
    def _market_for(self, security: Security, day: date):
        """(close date, close, fx) from the cache, or the provider's answer."""
        fetched = self._market.get((security.symbol, day))
        if fetched is not None:
            return fetched
        cached = close_on(self._session, security.id, day)
        rate = fx_rate(self._session, security.currency, on=day)
        pair = fx_pair(security.currency)
        fx_fresh = pair is None or rate is not None
        if cached is not None and day - cached.price_date <= _MAX_CACHE_GAP and fx_fresh:
            return cached.price_date, cached.close * self._split_factor(security, day), rate
        return None

    def _split_factor(self, security: Security, day: date) -> float:
        """Provider closes before a registered split are adjusted; undo that."""
        splits = (self._session.query(InvestmentTransaction)
                  .filter(InvestmentTransaction.user_id == self._user_id,
                          InvestmentTransaction.security_id == security.id,
                          InvestmentTransaction.kind == InvestmentKind.split).all())
        return split_factor_after(splits, security.id, day)

    def _update_market_hints(self) -> None:
        security = self._security()
        kind = self._kind()
        self._suggested_close = None
        if security is None or kind not in (InvestmentKind.buy, InvestmentKind.sell,
                                            InvestmentKind.grant):
            self._lbl_close.setText("")
            self._btn_use_close.setVisible(False)
            return
        day = self._trade_date()
        market = self._market_for(security, day)
        if market is None:
            self._lbl_close.setText("Consultando cotización…")
            self._btn_use_close.setVisible(False)
            self._lookup(security, day)
            return
        close_date, close, _rate = market
        if close is None:
            self._lbl_close.setText("Sin cotización ese día")
            self._btn_use_close.setVisible(False)
            return
        self._suggested_close = close
        self._lbl_close.setText(
            f"Cierre del {fmt_date(close_date)}: {fmt_money(close, security.currency, 2)}")
        self._btn_use_close.setVisible(True)

    def _lookup(self, security: Security, day: date) -> None:
        key = (security.symbol, day)
        if self._pending_lookup == key:
            return
        self._pending_lookup = key
        symbols = [security.symbol]
        pair = fx_pair(security.currency)
        if pair:
            symbols.append(fx_symbol(pair[0]))
        provider = self._provider
        start = day - timedelta(days=10)

        def fetch():
            return provider.daily_closes(symbols, start=start, end=day)

        def done(closes, error):
            self._pending_lookup = None
            if error is not None:
                self._market[key] = (None, None, None)
            else:
                rows = [r for r in closes.get(security.symbol, []) if r[0] <= day]
                close_date, close = rows[-1] if rows else (None, None)
                if close is not None:
                    close *= self._split_factor(security, day)
                rate = 1.0
                if pair:
                    fx_rows = [r for r in closes.get(fx_symbol(pair[0]), []) if r[0] <= day]
                    rate = fx_rows[-1][1] * pair[1] if fx_rows else None
                self._market[key] = (close_date, close, rate)
            current = self._security()
            if current is not None and (current.symbol, self._trade_date()) == key:
                self._update_market_hints()
                self._update_estimate_label()

        self._runner.run(fetch, done, latest_only=True)

    def _use_close(self) -> None:
        if self._suggested_close is not None:
            self._price.setValue(self._suggested_close)

    # -- EUR estimate ----------------------------------------------------
    def _current_fx(self, security: Security) -> Optional[float]:
        market = self._market_for(security, self._trade_date())
        if market is not None and market[2] is not None:
            return market[2]
        return fx_rate(self._session, security.currency, on=self._trade_date())

    def _update_estimate_label(self) -> None:
        security = self._security()
        kind = self._kind()
        self._btn_recalc.setVisible(not self._amount_auto and kind in (
            InvestmentKind.buy, InvestmentKind.sell))
        if security is None or kind not in (InvestmentKind.buy, InvestmentKind.sell,
                                            InvestmentKind.grant):
            self._lbl_estimate.setText("")
            return
        fx = self._current_fx(security)
        estimate = estimate_amount_eur(kind, self._qty.value(), self._price.value(),
                                       self._fees.value(), fx)
        if self._amount_auto and estimate is not None and kind != InvestmentKind.grant:
            self._set_amount(estimate)
        if security.currency == "EUR":
            text = "Acciones × precio ± comisiones."
        elif fx:
            per_eur = fx / (fx_pair(security.currency) or ("", 1.0))[1]
            text = (f"Estimado con 1 € = {fmt_number(per_eur, 4)} "
                    f"{fx_pair(security.currency)[0]}.")
        else:
            text = "Sin tipo de cambio para esa fecha: escribe el importe del extracto."
        if security.currency != "EUR":
            text += " Corrígelo con el importe exacto en EUR del extracto del bróker."
        self._lbl_estimate.setText(text)

    # -- search / save ---------------------------------------------------
    def _open_search(self) -> None:
        dialog = SecuritySearchDialog(self._session, self._provider, self._t, parent=self)
        if dialog.exec() == QDialog.DialogCode.Accepted and dialog.security is not None:
            self.created_security = True
            self._reload_securities(dialog.security.id)

    def draft(self) -> TransactionDraft:
        security = self._security()
        kind = self._kind()
        return TransactionDraft(
            id=self._editing.id if self._editing else None,
            security_id=security.id if security else 0,
            kind=kind,
            trade_date=self._trade_date(),
            broker=self._cmb_broker.currentText(),
            quantity=self._qty.value(),
            price=self._price.value() or None,
            currency=security.currency if security else None,
            amount_eur=self._amount.value(),
            fees_eur=self._fees.value(),
            tax_withheld_eur=self._withheld.value(),
            cash_paid_eur=self._cash_paid.value() if kind == InvestmentKind.grant else None,
            split_ratio=self._ratio.value() or None,
            notes=self._notes.text(),
        )

    def _save(self) -> None:
        if self._security() is None:
            self._show_error("Selecciona un valor (o búscalo con «Buscar…»).")
            return
        try:
            self.saved = save_transaction(self._session, self._user_id, self.draft())
        except LedgerError as exc:
            self._show_error(str(exc))
            return
        self.accept()

    def done(self, result: int) -> None:
        self._runner.shutdown()
        super().done(result)



# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Dividends / splits detected on the provider but not registered
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
class PendingEventsDialog(QDialog):
    """List detected events; register one (opens the entry form) or dismiss it."""

    def __init__(self, session: Session, user_id: int, provider: MarketDataProvider,
                 theme: dict, events: list, on_dismiss, parent: Optional[QWidget] = None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self._session = session
        self._user_id = user_id
        self._provider = provider
        self._t = theme
        self._events = list(events)
        self._on_dismiss = on_dismiss
        self.registered = 0

        self.setWindowTitle("Dividendos y splits pendientes")
        self.setModal(True)
        self.resize(820, 440)
        layout = QVBoxLayout(self)
        layout.setContentsMargins(22, 20, 22, 18)
        layout.setSpacing(10)
        title = QLabel("Dividendos y splits pendientes de registrar")
        title.setObjectName("dlgTitle")
        layout.addWidget(title)
        hint = QLabel(
            "Yahoo Finance indica estos eventos en fechas en las que tenías acciones. El importe es "
            "una estimación bruta: al registrarlo, escribe el neto cobrado y la retención que "
            "aparecen en el extracto del bróker. Descarta los que no te correspondan.")
        hint.setObjectName("dlgHint")
        hint.setWordWrap(True)
        layout.addWidget(hint)

        self._table = QTableWidget(0, 5)
        self._table.setHorizontalHeaderLabels(
            ["Tipo", "Valor", "Fecha ex-dividendo / split", "Acciones", "Estimación"])
        self._table.setSelectionBehavior(QAbstractItemView.SelectionBehavior.SelectRows)
        self._table.setSelectionMode(QAbstractItemView.SelectionMode.SingleSelection)
        self._table.setEditTriggers(QAbstractItemView.EditTrigger.NoEditTriggers)
        self._table.verticalHeader().setVisible(False)
        self._table.setAlternatingRowColors(True)
        self._table.setShowGrid(False)
        header = self._table.horizontalHeader()
        for col in range(5):
            header.setSectionResizeMode(col, QHeaderView.ResizeMode.ResizeToContents)
        header.setSectionResizeMode(1, QHeaderView.ResizeMode.Stretch)
        self._table.doubleClicked.connect(lambda _: self._register())
        layout.addWidget(self._table, 1)

        buttons = QHBoxLayout()
        self._btn_dismiss = QPushButton("Descartar")
        self._btn_dismiss.setObjectName("btnSecondary")
        self._btn_dismiss.setToolTip("No volver a proponer este evento")
        self._btn_dismiss.clicked.connect(self._dismiss)
        buttons.addWidget(self._btn_dismiss)
        buttons.addStretch()
        close = QPushButton("Cerrar")
        close.setObjectName("btnSecondary")
        close.clicked.connect(self.accept)
        buttons.addWidget(close)
        self._btn_register = QPushButton("Registrar…")
        self._btn_register.setObjectName("btnPrimary")
        self._btn_register.clicked.connect(self._register)
        buttons.addWidget(self._btn_register)
        layout.addLayout(buttons)
        self.setStyleSheet(dialog_stylesheet(theme))
        self._fill()

    def _fill(self) -> None:
        self._table.setRowCount(len(self._events))
        for row, event in enumerate(self._events):
            if event.kind == InvestmentKind.split:
                estimate = f"{fmt_quantity(event.ratio)} acciones nuevas por cada una"
            elif event.gross_eur is not None:
                estimate = (f"≈ {fmt_money(event.gross_eur, 'EUR')} brutos "
                            f"({fmt_money(event.per_share, event.currency, 4)} por acción)")
            else:
                estimate = f"{fmt_money(event.per_share, event.currency, 4)} por acción"
            values = [KIND_LABELS[event.kind], f"{event.name}  ·  {event.symbol}",
                      fmt_date(event.ex_date), fmt_quantity(event.shares), estimate]
            for col, value in enumerate(values):
                self._table.setItem(row, col, QTableWidgetItem(value))
        if self._events:
            self._table.selectRow(0)
        has = bool(self._events)
        self._btn_register.setEnabled(has)
        self._btn_dismiss.setEnabled(has)

    def _selected(self):
        rows = self._table.selectionModel().selectedRows()
        return self._events[rows[0].row()] if rows else None

    def _register(self) -> None:
        event = self._selected()
        if event is None:
            return
        if event.kind == InvestmentKind.split:
            prefill = {"trade_date": event.ex_date, "split_ratio": event.ratio,
                       "hint": f"Split de {event.name} detectado en Yahoo Finance."}
        else:
            prefill = {"trade_date": event.ex_date, "amount_eur": event.gross_eur,
                       "hint": ("Dividendo detectado en Yahoo Finance. Cambia la fecha por la de "
                                "cobro y el importe por el neto del extracto; indica la retención.")}
        dialog = TransactionDialog(self._session, self._user_id, self._provider, self._t,
                                   default_security_id=event.security_id,
                                   default_kind=event.kind, prefill=prefill, parent=self)
        if dialog.exec() == QDialog.DialogCode.Accepted:
            self.registered += 1
            self._events.remove(event)
            self._fill()

    def _dismiss(self) -> None:
        event = self._selected()
        if event is None:
            return
        self._on_dismiss(event)
        self._events.remove(event)
        self._fill()
```

## `app/gui/investment_import.py`

```python
"""
app/gui/investment_import.py
============================
FAMILYFIN — "Importar extracto" dialog of the Inversiones view.

Supported files (detected from their header, see importers.service.parse_any):
  * DEGIRO "Estado de cuenta" (.xlsx / .csv): exact operations;
  * MyInvestor account movements (.csv / .xlsx): amounts only — the kind of
    each movement is guessed and quantities are estimated from the day's
    price, both editable here.

  1. Choose the file. It is parsed locally.
  2. Each product's Yahoo symbol is looked up in the background; the
     proposal and its alternatives appear in an editable combo.
  3. When quantities are missing, they are estimated in the background from
     the chosen symbols' closes (again after a symbol is changed).
  4. Preview of every movement, marked "Nueva" or "Ya importada".
  5. "Importar": data of new securities is fetched in the background, then
     everything is written for the logged-in user in one transaction.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from pathlib import Path
from typing import Dict, Optional

import qtawesome as qta
from PySide6.QtCore import Qt, QTimer
from PySide6.QtGui import QColor
from PySide6.QtWidgets import (
    QAbstractItemView,
    QComboBox,
    QDialog,
    QFileDialog,
    QHBoxLayout,
    QHeaderView,
    QLabel,
    QPushButton,
    QTableWidget,
    QTableWidgetItem,
    QVBoxLayout,
    QWidget,
)
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from app.gui._background import BackgroundRunner
from app.gui._format import fmt_date, fmt_eur, fmt_money, fmt_quantity
from app.gui.investment_dialogs import dialog_stylesheet
from app.investments.importers.base import KIND_BUY, KIND_DIVIDEND, KIND_IGNORE, KIND_SELL
from app.investments.importers.degiro import StatementError
from app.investments.importers.service import (
    ImportSummary,
    already_imported,
    apply_import,
    catalogue_isins,
    estimate_quantities,
    fetch_closes,
    fetch_security_infos,
    parse_any,
    symbols_to_fetch,
)
from app.investments.importers.symbols import listing_currency, suggest_symbols
from app.investments.market_data import MarketDataError, MarketDataProvider
from app.investments.portfolio import LedgerError

KIND_LABELS = {KIND_BUY: "Compra", KIND_SELL: "Venta", KIND_DIVIDEND: "Dividendo",
               KIND_IGNORE: "Ignorar"}
COL_KIND, COL_QTY = 2, 3


def _item(text: str, right: bool = False, color: Optional[str] = None,
          tooltip: Optional[str] = None, editable: bool = False) -> QTableWidgetItem:
    item = QTableWidgetItem(text)
    if right:
        item.setTextAlignment(Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignRight | Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignVCenter)
    if color:
        item.setForeground(QColor(color))
    if tooltip:
        item.setToolTip(tooltip)
    flags = item.flags()
    item.setFlags(flags | Qt.ItemFlag.ItemIsEditable if editable
                  else flags & ~Qt.ItemFlag.ItemIsEditable)
    return item


def _table(headers) -> QTableWidget:
    table = QTableWidget(0, len(headers))
    table.setHorizontalHeaderLabels(headers)
    table.setSelectionMode(QAbstractItemView.SelectionMode.NoSelection)
    table.setEditTriggers(QAbstractItemView.EditTrigger.DoubleClicked
                          | QAbstractItemView.EditTrigger.EditKeyPressed)
    table.verticalHeader().setVisible(False)
    table.verticalHeader().setDefaultSectionSize(36)
    table.setAlternatingRowColors(True)
    table.setShowGrid(False)
    return table


def _parse_quantity(text: str) -> Optional[float]:
    text = (text or "").strip().replace(".", "").replace(",", ".")
    try:
        value = float(text)
    except ValueError:
        return None
    return value if value > 0 else None


class ImportStatementDialog(QDialog):

    def __init__(self, session: Session, user_id: int, username: str,
                 provider: MarketDataProvider, theme: dict, parent: Optional[QWidget] = None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self._session = session
        self._user_id = user_id
        self._provider = provider
        self._t = theme
        self._runner = BackgroundRunner(self)
        self._prices = BackgroundRunner(self)
        self.statement = None
        self.summary: Optional[ImportSummary] = None
        self._combos: Dict[str, QComboBox] = {}
        self._known_refs: set = set()
        self._filling = False
        self._estimate_timer = QTimer(self)
        self._estimate_timer.setSingleShot(True)
        self._estimate_timer.setInterval(500)
        self._estimate_timer.timeout.connect(self._estimate)

        self.setWindowTitle("Importar extracto del bróker")
        self.setModal(True)
        self.resize(1120, 740)
        layout = QVBoxLayout(self)
        layout.setContentsMargins(22, 20, 22, 18)
        layout.setSpacing(10)

        title = QLabel(f"Importar extracto del bróker · {username}")
        title.setObjectName("dlgTitle")
        layout.addWidget(title)
        hint = QLabel(
            "Admite el «Estado de cuenta» de DEGIRO y los movimientos de cuenta de MyInvestor "
            "(Excel o CSV, desde la apertura de la cuenta). Las operaciones se añaden al usuario con "
            "el que has iniciado sesión; las ya importadas se reconocen y no se duplican. En "
            "MyInvestor revisa el tipo de cada movimiento y las acciones estimadas (doble clic para "
            "corregirlas).")
        hint.setObjectName("dlgHint")
        hint.setWordWrap(True)
        layout.addWidget(hint)

        row = QHBoxLayout()
        self._btn_file = QPushButton(" Elegir archivo…")
        self._btn_file.setObjectName("btnSecondary")
        self._btn_file.setIcon(qta.icon("mdi.file-excel-outline", color=theme["income"]))
        self._btn_file.clicked.connect(self._choose_file)
        row.addWidget(self._btn_file)
        self._lbl_file = QLabel("Ningún archivo seleccionado")
        self._lbl_file.setObjectName("dlgHint")
        row.addWidget(self._lbl_file, 1)
        layout.addLayout(row)

        self._lbl_securities = QLabel("Valores y su cotización en Yahoo Finance")
        self._lbl_securities.setObjectName("sectionTitle")
        layout.addWidget(self._lbl_securities)
        self._securities = _table(["Clave", "Valor", "Cotización (Yahoo)", "Comprobación"])
        self._securities.verticalHeader().setDefaultSectionSize(40)    # room for the combos
        layout.addWidget(self._securities, 2)

        self._lbl_ops = QLabel("Operaciones")
        self._lbl_ops.setObjectName("sectionTitle")
        layout.addWidget(self._lbl_ops)
        self._ops = _table(["Fecha", "Valor", "Tipo", "Acciones", "Precio", "Importe (EUR)",
                            "Comisiones / retención", "Estado"])
        self._ops.itemChanged.connect(self._on_item_changed)
        layout.addWidget(self._ops, 3)

        self._lbl_status = QLabel("")
        self._lbl_status.setObjectName("dlgHint")
        self._lbl_status.setWordWrap(True)
        layout.addWidget(self._lbl_status)

        buttons = QHBoxLayout()
        buttons.addStretch()
        cancel = QPushButton("Cancelar")
        cancel.setObjectName("btnSecondary")
        cancel.clicked.connect(self.reject)
        buttons.addWidget(cancel)
        self._btn_import = QPushButton("Importar")
        self._btn_import.setObjectName("btnPrimary")
        self._btn_import.setEnabled(False)
        self._btn_import.clicked.connect(self._import)
        buttons.addWidget(self._btn_import)
        layout.addLayout(buttons)
        self.setStyleSheet(dialog_stylesheet(theme) + f"""
            QLabel#sectionTitle {{ color: {theme["text_primary"]}; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; }}
        """)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    @property
    def busy(self) -> bool:
        return self._runner.busy or self._prices.busy or self._estimate_timer.isActive()

    def _set_status(self, text: str, error: bool = False) -> None:
        self._lbl_status.setText(text)
        self._lbl_status.setStyleSheet(
            f"color: {self._t['expense']}; font-weight: 600;" if error else "")

    def _choose_file(self) -> None:
        start = str(Path.home() / "Downloads")
        path, _ = QFileDialog.getOpenFileName(
            self, "Extracto del bróker", start, "Extracto DEGIRO / MyInvestor (*.xlsx *.csv)")
        if path:
            self.load_file(path)

    def load_file(self, path) -> None:
        path = Path(path)
        try:
            statement = parse_any(path)
        except (StatementError, OSError) as exc:
            self._set_status(str(exc), error=True)
            return
        self.statement = statement
        self._known_refs = already_imported(self._session, self._user_id, statement)
        self._lbl_file.setText(
            f"{path.name} · {statement.broker} · del {fmt_date(statement.first_day)} "
            f"al {fmt_date(statement.last_day)}")
        self._fill_operations()
        self._fill_securities({})
        self._set_status("Buscando la cotización de cada valor en Yahoo Finance…")
        self._btn_import.setEnabled(False)
        provider, products = self._provider, statement.products
        catalogue = catalogue_isins(self._session)
        self._runner.run(lambda: suggest_symbols(provider, products, catalogue),
                         self._on_symbols, latest_only=True)

    def _on_symbols(self, choices, error) -> None:
        if error is not None:
            self._set_status(f"No se pudo consultar Yahoo Finance ({error}). Escribe el símbolo "
                             "de cada valor a mano.", error=True)
            choices = {}
        self._fill_securities(choices)
        if self.statement.needs_prices:
            self._estimate()
        self._update_ready()

    # -- securities ------------------------------------------------------
    def _fill_securities(self, choices) -> None:
        products = self.statement.products
        self._securities.setRowCount(len(products))
        self._combos = {}
        for row, (key, info) in enumerate(sorted(products.items(), key=lambda kv: kv[1]["name"])):
            choice = choices.get(key)
            label = key[5:] if key.startswith("NAME:") else key
            spellings = " / ".join(info.get("spellings") or [info["name"]])
            self._securities.setItem(row, 0, _item(label if not key.startswith("NAME:") else
                                                   ("Fondo" if info.get("fund") else "Nombre")))
            self._securities.setItem(row, 1, _item(info["name"], tooltip=spellings))
            combo = QComboBox()
            combo.setEditable(True)
            combo.setInsertPolicy(QComboBox.InsertPolicy.NoInsert)
            detail = "Buscando…"
            if choice is not None:
                for candidate in choice.candidates:
                    combo.addItem(f"{candidate.symbol}", candidate.symbol)
                    combo.setItemData(combo.count() - 1,
                                      f"{candidate.name} · {candidate.exchange} · {candidate.gap_text}",
                                      Qt.ItemDataRole.ToolTipRole)
                if choice.chosen and combo.findData(choice.chosen) < 0:
                    combo.insertItem(0, choice.chosen, choice.chosen)
                combo.setCurrentText(choice.chosen or "")
                best = next((c for c in choice.candidates if c.symbol == choice.chosen), None)
                if choice.from_catalogue:
                    detail = "Ya está en tu catálogo"
                elif best is None:
                    detail = "Sin coincidencia: escribe el símbolo de Yahoo"
                elif best.gap is not None:
                    detail = f"{best.exchange} · precio {best.gap_text}"
                else:
                    detail = f"{best.name} · {best.exchange} · compruébalo"
            combo.currentTextChanged.connect(lambda _t, k=key: self._on_symbol_edited(k))
            self._combos[key] = combo
            self._securities.setCellWidget(row, 2, combo)
            self._securities.setItem(row, 3, _item(detail))
        self._fit(self._securities, stretch=3)
        self._securities.setColumnWidth(2, 220)

    def _row_of(self, key: str) -> int:
        keys = sorted(self.statement.products, key=lambda k: self.statement.products[k]["name"])
        return keys.index(key)

    def _on_symbol_edited(self, key: str) -> None:
        text = self._combos[key].currentText().strip().upper()
        currency = self.statement.products[key]["currency"]
        listing = listing_currency(text) if text else None
        note = ("Cotiza en otra divisa que la compra" if listing and listing != currency
                else "Elegido a mano")
        self._securities.setItem(self._row_of(key), 3, _item(
            note, color=self._t["warning"] if "divisa" in note else None))
        if self.statement.needs_prices:
            self._estimate_timer.start()
        self._update_ready()

    # -- quantity estimation (MyInvestor) --------------------------------
    def _estimate(self) -> None:
        self._estimate_timer.stop()
        statement, symbols, provider = self.statement, self.symbols(), self._provider
        self._set_status("Estimando las acciones con los precios de Yahoo Finance…")
        self._prices.run(lambda: fetch_closes(provider, statement, symbols),
                         lambda closes, error: self._on_closes(symbols, closes, error),
                         latest_only=True)

    def _on_closes(self, symbols, closes, error) -> None:
        if error is not None:
            self._set_status(f"No se pudieron obtener precios para estimar las acciones ({error}). "
                             "Escríbelas a mano con doble clic.", error=True)
            closes = {}
        estimate_quantities(self.statement, symbols, closes)
        self._fill_operations()
        self._update_ready()

    # -- operations ------------------------------------------------------
    def _fill_operations(self) -> None:
        statement, t = self.statement, self._t
        self._filling = True
        rows = sorted(statement.rows, key=lambda r: (r.day, r.ref))
        self._rows = rows
        self._ops.setRowCount(len(rows))
        for index, row in enumerate(rows):
            known = row.ref in self._known_refs
            if known:
                state = _item("Ya importada", color=t["text_secondary"])
            elif row.kind == KIND_IGNORE:
                state = _item("Se ignora", color=t["text_secondary"], tooltip=row.note)
            else:
                state = _item("Nueva", color=t["income"], tooltip=row.note or None)
            trade = row.kind in (KIND_BUY, KIND_SELL)
            if trade and row.quantity:
                qty_text = fmt_quantity(row.quantity)
            elif trade:
                qty_text = "¿?"
            else:
                qty_text = "—"
            qty = _item(qty_text, right=True, editable=trade and not known,
                        color=t["warning"] if trade and (row.quantity_estimated or not row.quantity)
                        else None,
                        tooltip=("Estimada: doble clic para corregirla" if row.quantity_estimated
                                 else None))
            sign = -1 if row.kind == KIND_BUY else 1
            amount = row.amount_eur
            values = [
                _item(fmt_date(row.day)), _item(row.name, tooltip=row.note or None), None, qty,
                _item(fmt_money(row.price, row.currency, 2) if trade and row.price else
                      (row.gross_text or "—"), right=True),
                _item("se estimará" if amount is None else
                      fmt_eur(sign * amount, signed=True) if row.kind != KIND_IGNORE else fmt_eur(amount),
                      right=True, color=(t["text_secondary"] if row.kind == KIND_IGNORE else
                                         t["expense"] if row.kind == KIND_BUY else t["income"])),
                _item(fmt_eur(row.fees_eur) if row.fees_eur else
                      fmt_eur(row.withheld_eur) if row.withheld_eur else "—", right=True),
                state,
            ]
            for col, item in enumerate(values):
                if item is not None:
                    self._ops.setItem(index, col, item)
            if row.kind_editable and not known:
                combo = QComboBox()
                for kind, label in KIND_LABELS.items():
                    combo.addItem(label, kind)
                combo.setCurrentIndex(combo.findData(row.kind))
                combo.currentIndexChanged.connect(
                    lambda _i, r=row, c=combo: self._on_kind_changed(r, c.currentData()))
                self._ops.setCellWidget(index, COL_KIND, combo)
            else:
                self._ops.removeCellWidget(index, COL_KIND)
                self._ops.setItem(index, COL_KIND, _item(
                    KIND_LABELS[row.kind] + (f" ({row.fills} ejec.)" if row.fills > 1 else "")))
        self._filling = False
        self._fit(self._ops, stretch=1)
        self._ops.setColumnWidth(COL_KIND, max(self._ops.columnWidth(COL_KIND), 120))
        new = [r for r in rows if r.ref not in self._known_refs and r.kind != KIND_IGNORE]
        trades = sum(1 for r in new if r.kind in (KIND_BUY, KIND_SELL))
        self._lbl_ops.setText(f"Movimientos · {trades} compras/ventas y {len(new) - trades} "
                              f"dividendos nuevos · {len(rows) - len(new)} ya importados o ignorados")
        self._new = len(new)

    def _on_kind_changed(self, row, kind) -> None:
        row.kind = kind
        if kind in (KIND_BUY, KIND_SELL) and not row.quantity:
            row.quantity_estimated = True
            self._estimate_timer.start()
        if kind not in (KIND_BUY, KIND_SELL):
            row.quantity = row.price = None
        QTimer.singleShot(0, self._refresh_after_edit)

    def _refresh_after_edit(self) -> None:
        self._fill_operations()
        self._update_ready()

    def _on_item_changed(self, item: QTableWidgetItem) -> None:
        if self._filling or item.column() != COL_QTY:
            return
        row = self._rows[item.row()]
        quantity = _parse_quantity(item.text())
        row.quantity = quantity
        row.quantity_estimated = False           # typed by the user: keep it
        row.price = round(row.amount_eur / quantity, 4) if quantity and row.amount_eur else None
        QTimer.singleShot(0, self._refresh_after_edit)

    @staticmethod
    def _fit(table: QTableWidget, stretch: int) -> None:
        table.resizeColumnsToContents()
        table.horizontalHeader().setSectionResizeMode(stretch, QHeaderView.ResizeMode.Stretch)

    def symbols(self) -> Dict[str, str]:
        return {key: combo.currentText().strip().upper() for key, combo in self._combos.items()}

    def _update_ready(self) -> None:
        if self.statement is None:
            return
        used = {r.key for r in self.statement.rows if r.kind != KIND_IGNORE
                and r.ref not in self._known_refs}
        missing = [k for k, s in self.symbols().items() if not s and k in used]
        no_qty = [r for r in self.statement.rows if r.kind in (KIND_BUY, KIND_SELL)
                  and not r.quantity and r.ref not in self._known_refs]
        if missing:
            text = f"Falta el símbolo de {len(missing)} valor(es)."
        elif no_qty:
            text = (f"Faltan las acciones de {len(no_qty)} movimiento(s): escríbelas con doble clic "
                    "en la columna «Acciones».")
        elif not self._new:
            text = "Todas las operaciones de este extracto ya estaban importadas."
        else:
            text = f"Listo para importar {self._new} movimientos nuevos."
        if self.statement.ignored:
            text += " Se ignoran: " + ", ".join(
                f"{k} ({v})" for k, v in self.statement.ignored.items()) + "."
        if self.statement.warnings:
            text += " Avisos: " + " ".join(self.statement.warnings)
        self._set_status(text)
        self._btn_import.setEnabled(bool(self._new) and not missing and not no_qty
                                    and not self.busy)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _import(self) -> None:
        symbols = self.symbols()
        to_fetch = symbols_to_fetch(self._session, symbols.values())
        self._btn_import.setEnabled(False)
        self._set_status("Obteniendo los datos de los valores nuevos…")
        provider = self._provider
        self._runner.run(lambda: fetch_security_infos(provider, to_fetch),
                         lambda infos, error: self._finish_import(symbols, infos, error))

    def _finish_import(self, symbols, infos, error) -> None:
        if error is not None:
            message = str(error) if isinstance(error, MarketDataError) else f"Error: {error}"
            self._set_status(f"No se pudieron obtener los datos de algún valor: {message}", error=True)
            self._btn_import.setEnabled(True)
            return
        try:
            self.summary = apply_import(self._session, self._user_id, self.statement, symbols, infos)
        except LedgerError as exc:
            self._set_status(f"No se ha importado nada: {exc}", error=True)
            self._btn_import.setEnabled(True)
            return
        self.accept()

    def done(self, result: int) -> None:
        self._estimate_timer.stop()
        self._runner.shutdown()
        self._prices.shutdown()
        super().done(result)

```

## `app/gui/investment_positions.py`

```python
"""
app/gui/investment_positions.py
===============================
FAMILYFIN — "Posiciones" tab of the Inversiones view.

  KPI cards   Valor de mercado · Capital invertido · Plusvalía latente ·
              Variación del día · Realizado <año> · Dividendos <año> ·
              Rentabilidad anual (XIRR)
  banner      securities without a usable price (valued at cost)
  table       one row per open position (closed ones on request)

Everything comes from investments.snapshot.portfolio_snapshot(), which only
reads the local cache; the view reloads this panel after each price refresh.
Double-clicking a row emits `security_activated(symbol)` so the view can
jump to that security's operations.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from typing import List, Optional

from PySide6.QtCore import QSortFilterProxyModel, Qt, Signal
from PySide6.QtGui import QColor, QFont, QStandardItem, QStandardItemModel
from PySide6.QtWidgets import (
    QAbstractItemView,
    QCheckBox,
    QComboBox,
    QFrame,
    QGridLayout,
    QHBoxLayout,
    QHeaderView,
    QLabel,
    QTableView,
    QVBoxLayout,
    QWidget,
)
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from app.db.models import InvestmentTransaction
from app.gui._format import fmt_date, fmt_eur, fmt_money, fmt_pct, fmt_quantity
from app.gui.dashboard import _KPICard
from app.investments.snapshot import PortfolioSnapshot, PositionRow, portfolio_snapshot

SORT_ROLE = Qt.ItemDataRole.UserRole + 1
SYMBOL_ROLE = Qt.ItemDataRole.UserRole + 2

COLUMNS = ["Valor", "Acciones", "Coste medio (EUR)", "Cotización", "Día",
           "Valor (EUR)", "Peso", "Plusvalía (EUR)", "Plusvalía %", "Bróker"]

# XIRR over a few days extrapolates wildly; below this span it is not shown.
MIN_XIRR_DAYS = 30


class _MetricCard(_KPICard):
    """Dashboard KPI card whose main value can take a gain/loss colour."""

    def set_metric(self, value: str, sub: str = "", badge: str = "",
                   badge_positive: bool = True, value_color: Optional[str] = None) -> None:
        self.set_value(value, sub, badge, badge_positive)
        self._lbl_value.setStyleSheet(f"color: {value_color};" if value_color else "")


class PositionsPanel(QWidget):
    security_activated = Signal(str)

    def __init__(self, session: Session, user_id: int, theme: dict) -> None:
        super().__init__()
        self._session = session
        self._user_id = user_id
        self._t = theme
        self.snapshot: Optional[PortfolioSnapshot] = None
        self._build()

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _build(self) -> None:
        root = QVBoxLayout(self)
        root.setContentsMargins(20, 16, 20, 0)
        root.setSpacing(12)

        t = self._t
        grid = QGridLayout()
        grid.setHorizontalSpacing(14)
        grid.setVerticalSpacing(14)
        specs = [
            ("value", "Valor de mercado", "mdi.briefcase-outline", t["investment"]),
            ("cost", "Capital invertido", "mdi.cash-plus", t["accent"]),
            ("gain", "Plusvalía latente", "mdi.chart-line", t["income"]),
            ("day", "Variación del día", "mdi.calendar-today", t["accent"]),
            ("realized", "Realizado", "mdi.check-circle-outline", t["income"]),
            ("dividends", "Dividendos", "mdi.cash-multiple", t["income"]),
            ("xirr", "Rentabilidad anual", "mdi.percent-outline", t["investment"]),
        ]
        self._cards = {}
        for index, (key, label, icon, color) in enumerate(specs):
            card = _MetricCard(label, icon, color, t)
            card.setMinimumHeight(104)
            self._cards[key] = card
            grid.addWidget(card, index // 4, index % 4)
        root.addLayout(grid)

        self._banner = QLabel("")
        self._banner.setObjectName("invBanner")
        self._banner.setWordWrap(True)
        self._banner.setVisible(False)
        root.addWidget(self._banner)

        bar = QHBoxLayout()
        title = QLabel("Posiciones")
        title.setObjectName("sectionTitle")
        bar.addWidget(title)
        bar.addStretch()
        self._chk_closed = QCheckBox("Mostrar posiciones cerradas")
        self._chk_closed.toggled.connect(self._fill_table)
        bar.addWidget(self._chk_closed)
        self._cmb_broker = QComboBox()
        self._cmb_broker.setObjectName("filterCombo")
        self._cmb_broker.setFixedHeight(32)
        self._cmb_broker.setMinimumWidth(160)
        self._cmb_broker.currentIndexChanged.connect(self.reload)
        bar.addWidget(self._cmb_broker)
        root.addLayout(bar)

        self._model = QStandardItemModel(0, len(COLUMNS))
        self._model.setHorizontalHeaderLabels(COLUMNS)
        self._proxy = QSortFilterProxyModel(self)
        self._proxy.setSourceModel(self._model)
        self._proxy.setSortRole(SORT_ROLE)
        self._table = QTableView()
        self._table.setObjectName("invTable")
        self._table.setModel(self._proxy)
        self._table.setSelectionBehavior(QAbstractItemView.SelectionBehavior.SelectRows)
        self._table.setSelectionMode(QAbstractItemView.SelectionMode.SingleSelection)
        self._table.setEditTriggers(QAbstractItemView.EditTrigger.NoEditTriggers)
        self._table.setAlternatingRowColors(True)
        self._table.setShowGrid(False)
        self._table.setSortingEnabled(True)
        self._table.verticalHeader().setVisible(False)
        self._table.doubleClicked.connect(self._on_double_click)
        self._table.setToolTip("Doble clic para ver las operaciones de este valor")
        header = self._table.horizontalHeader()
        for col in range(len(COLUMNS)):
            header.setSectionResizeMode(col, QHeaderView.ResizeMode.ResizeToContents)
        header.setSectionResizeMode(0, QHeaderView.ResizeMode.Stretch)
        # Default order: largest position first (Qt would pick column 0).
        self._table.sortByColumn(5, Qt.SortOrder.DescendingOrder)
        root.addWidget(self._table, 1)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def reload(self, *_args) -> None:
        self._load_brokers()
        self.snapshot = portfolio_snapshot(self._session, self._user_id,
                                           broker=self._cmb_broker.currentData())
        self._fill_cards()
        self._fill_banner()
        self._fill_table()

    def _load_brokers(self) -> None:
        current = self._cmb_broker.currentData()
        brokers = sorted(b for (b,) in self._session.query(InvestmentTransaction.broker)
                         .filter(InvestmentTransaction.user_id == self._user_id).distinct())
        self._cmb_broker.blockSignals(True)
        self._cmb_broker.clear()
        self._cmb_broker.addItem("Todos los brókers", None)
        for broker in brokers:
            self._cmb_broker.addItem(broker, broker)
        index = self._cmb_broker.findData(current) if current else 0
        self._cmb_broker.setCurrentIndex(max(index, 0))
        self._cmb_broker.setVisible(len(brokers) > 1)
        self._cmb_broker.blockSignals(False)

    def _gain_color(self, value: Optional[float]) -> Optional[str]:
        if value is None or abs(value) < 0.005:
            return None
        return self._t["income"] if value > 0 else self._t["expense"]

    def _fill_cards(self) -> None:
        snap = self.snapshot
        tot = snap.totals
        year = snap.as_of.year
        n = tot.open_positions
        prices = (f" · precios del {fmt_date(tot.last_price_date)}"
                  if tot.last_price_date else "")
        c = self._cards
        c["value"].set_metric(fmt_eur(tot.market_value_eur),
                              (f"{n} posición abierta" if n == 1 else f"{n} posiciones abiertas") + prices)
        c["cost"].set_metric(fmt_eur(tot.cost_basis_eur), "Coste FIFO de lo que tienes")
        c["gain"].set_metric(fmt_eur(tot.unrealized_gain_eur, signed=True),
                             "Si vendieras hoy, antes de impuestos",
                             fmt_pct(tot.unrealized_pct) if tot.unrealized_pct is not None else "",
                             tot.unrealized_gain_eur >= 0,
                             self._gain_color(tot.unrealized_gain_eur))
        c["day"].set_metric(fmt_eur(tot.day_change_eur, signed=True),
                            "Último cierre frente al anterior",
                            fmt_pct(tot.day_change_pct) if tot.day_change_pct is not None else "",
                            tot.day_change_eur >= 0,
                            self._gain_color(tot.day_change_eur))
        c["realized"]._lbl_label.setText(f"Realizado {year}")
        c["realized"].set_metric(fmt_eur(tot.realized_ytd_eur, signed=True),
                                 f"Ventas FIFO · histórico {fmt_eur(tot.realized_total_eur, signed=True)}",
                                 value_color=self._gain_color(tot.realized_ytd_eur))
        c["dividends"]._lbl_label.setText(f"Dividendos {year}")
        c["dividends"].set_metric(fmt_eur(tot.dividends_ytd_eur),
                                  f"Netos · histórico {fmt_eur(tot.dividends_total_eur)}")
        first = self._first_trade_date()
        if tot.xirr is not None and first and (snap.as_of - first).days >= MIN_XIRR_DAYS:
            c["xirr"].set_metric(fmt_pct(tot.xirr), "Anualizada según cuándo invertiste cada euro",
                                 value_color=self._gain_color(tot.xirr))
        else:
            c["xirr"].set_metric("—", "Hace falta al menos un mes de historial")

    def _first_trade_date(self):
        from sqlalchemy import func
        return (self._session.query(func.min(InvestmentTransaction.trade_date))
                .filter(InvestmentTransaction.user_id == self._user_id).scalar())

    def _fill_banner(self) -> None:
        missing = self.snapshot.totals.missing_prices
        stale = [r.security.symbol for r in self.snapshot.open_rows if r.stale]
        parts = []
        if missing:
            parts.append(f"Sin cotización todavía para {', '.join(missing)}: se valoran a su coste "
                         "hasta la próxima actualización.")
        if stale:
            parts.append(f"Cotización con más de una semana de antigüedad: {', '.join(stale)}.")
        self._banner.setText(" ".join(parts))
        self._banner.setVisible(bool(parts))

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _fill_table(self, *_args) -> None:
        if self.snapshot is None:
            return
        rows = self.snapshot.rows if self._chk_closed.isChecked() else self.snapshot.open_rows
        sort_column, sort_order = self._proxy.sortColumn(), self._proxy.sortOrder()
        self._table.setSortingEnabled(False)
        self._model.removeRows(0, self._model.rowCount())
        for row in rows:
            self._model.appendRow(self._make_row(row))
        self._table.setSortingEnabled(True)
        self._table.sortByColumn(sort_column, sort_order)

    def _make_row(self, row: PositionRow) -> List[QStandardItem]:
        t = self._t
        security = row.security

        def cell(text, sort=None, right=True, color=None, tooltip=None, bold=False):
            item = QStandardItem(text)
            item.setData(sort if sort is not None else text.lower(), SORT_ROLE)
            item.setData(security.symbol, SYMBOL_ROLE)
            if right:
                item.setTextAlignment(Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignRight | Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignVCenter)
            if color:
                item.setForeground(QColor(color))
            if tooltip:
                item.setToolTip(tooltip)
            if bold:
                font = QFont()
                font.setBold(True)
                item.setFont(font)
            return item

        name = cell(f"{security.name}  ·  {security.symbol}", right=False,
                    tooltip=" · ".join(p for p in (security.exchange, security.currency,
                                                   security.isin) if p))
        if not row.is_open:
            name.setForeground(QColor(t["text_secondary"]))

        if row.price is None:
            price_text, price_tip, price_color = "—", "Sin cotización guardada", t["warning"]
        else:
            price_text = fmt_money(row.price, security.currency, 2)
            price_tip = f"Cierre del {fmt_date(row.price_date)}"
            price_color = t["warning"] if (row.stale or not row.has_price) else None
            if row.stale:
                price_tip += " (antigua)"

        if row.is_open:
            gain_cell = cell(fmt_eur(row.unrealized_gain_eur, signed=True) if row.has_price else "—",
                             sort=row.unrealized_gain_eur,
                             color=self._gain_color(row.unrealized_gain_eur), bold=True,
                             tooltip=(f"Realizado: {fmt_eur(row.realized_gain_eur, signed=True)} · "
                                      f"Dividendos: {fmt_eur(row.dividends_eur)}"))
            pct_cell = cell(fmt_pct(row.unrealized_pct), sort=row.unrealized_pct or 0.0,
                            color=self._gain_color(row.unrealized_pct))
        else:
            gain_cell = cell(fmt_eur(row.total_return_eur, signed=True), sort=row.total_return_eur,
                             color=self._gain_color(row.total_return_eur), bold=True,
                             tooltip="Posición cerrada: realizado + dividendos")
            pct_cell = cell("cerrada", sort=-1e9, color=t["text_secondary"])

        return [
            name,
            cell(fmt_quantity(row.quantity), sort=row.quantity),
            cell(fmt_eur(row.average_cost_eur) if row.average_cost_eur is not None else "—",
                 sort=row.average_cost_eur or 0.0),
            cell(price_text, sort=row.price or 0.0, color=price_color, tooltip=price_tip),
            cell(fmt_pct(row.day_change_pct), sort=row.day_change_pct or 0.0,
                 color=self._gain_color(row.day_change_pct),
                 tooltip=fmt_eur(row.day_change_eur, signed=True)
                 if row.day_change_eur is not None else None),
            cell(fmt_eur(row.market_value_eur) if row.is_open else "—",
                 sort=row.market_value_eur, bold=True,
                 color=t["warning"] if not row.has_price else None,
                 tooltip=None if row.has_price else "Valorada a coste: falta la cotización"),
            cell(fmt_pct(row.weight, signed=False) if row.is_open else "—", sort=row.weight),
            gain_cell,
            pct_cell,
            cell(", ".join(row.brokers), right=False),
        ]

    def _on_double_click(self, index) -> None:
        symbol = self._proxy.data(index, SYMBOL_ROLE)
        if symbol:
            self.security_activated.emit(symbol)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def apply_theme(self, theme: dict) -> None:
        self._t = theme
        for card in self._cards.values():
            card.apply_style(theme)
        t = theme
        self._banner.setStyleSheet(
            f"QLabel#invBanner {{ background-color: {t['bg_secondary']}; color: {t['warning']};"
            f" border: 1px solid {t['warning']}; border-radius: 8px; padding: 8px 12px;"
            f" font-size: 12px; }}")
        self.setStyleSheet(f"""
            QLabel#sectionTitle {{ color: {t["text_primary"]}; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; }}
            QCheckBox {{ color: {t["text_secondary"]}; font-size: 12px; background: transparent; }}
        """)
        if self.snapshot is not None:
            self._fill_cards()
            self._fill_table()
```
